edinh86/memoryeditor.name: MemoryEditor v0.5.0 — Memory Workbench
edinh86/memoryeditor.body:
The big one: a **Memory Workbench** that brings a Cheat-Engine-style workflow to the Steam Deck.

### 🧰 Memory Workbench (new)
Attach to a game, then press **Open Memory Workbench** in the Quick Access panel for a full-screen page with:

- **Address list** — add addresses by absolute value (`0x…`) or by **module + offset**, give each a label and a type, and watch its **live value**. Per row: set a new value, freeze/unfreeze, view in the hex viewer, or remove.
- **Memory viewer** — a **hex + ASCII** dump of any address.
- **Cheat tables** — **Save / Reload / Delete** a table of addresses per game, keyed by its **Steam App ID**, so your list is there next time.
- **Static tagging** — addresses inside a loaded module are labelled with the module name.
- **Add to Workbench** — send any search result straight into the saved table.

### Everything from before
Async scans with progress + cancel · live value refresh · value freezing + frozen panel · undo · hex/negative numpad entry · range + string search · auto-detect the running game.

### Install (Desktop Mode)
Download `memoryeditor-0.5.0.zip` below, copy it to the Deck, then:

    sudo rm -rf ~/homebrew/plugins/memory-deck ~/homebrew/plugins/memoryeditor
    sudo unzip memoryeditor-0.5.0.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/
    sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader

Requires [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader). Personal project — not on any plugin store; install the attached zip manually.

### Notes
- Found addresses aren't guaranteed to be the same after a game restart (ASLR). Saved tables keep your labels and types; re-find the address in a new session, or use `module + offset` for addresses inside a module. (Pointer scanning, which makes cheats survive restarts, is the next planned step.)
- This plugin reads and writes another process's memory. It can crash games. Use at your own risk.

edinh86/memoryeditor.name: MemoryEditor v0.4.1
edinh86/memoryeditor.body:
A revived and modernised fork of [Memory Deck](https://github.com/CameronRedmore/memory-deck) — a scanmem-based memory scanner/editor for the Steam Deck, as a Decky Loader plugin.

### What's in this release
- Modern Decky toolchain (`@decky/ui` + `@decky/api`, `api_version` 1)
- Async scans that no longer freeze the backend, with a live progress bar and a Cancel button
- Live value refresh in the results list (values tick in real time)
- Value freezing, with a dedicated **Frozen Values** panel
- Undo last change
- Hex / range / string search, plus negative and hex entry on the numpad
- Auto-detect the running game (🎮 one-tap attach)
- Correctness pass: fixed float search, the match-array walk, and `set N=` indexing
- Review cleanups: basename-based process filter, hex on signed types, quieter logging

### Install (Desktop Mode)
Download `memoryeditor-0.4.1.zip` below, copy it to the Deck, then:

    sudo rm -rf ~/homebrew/plugins/memory-deck ~/homebrew/plugins/memoryeditor
    sudo unzip memoryeditor-0.4.1.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/
    sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader

Requires [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader). This is a personal project and is not published to any plugin store — install the attached zip manually.

### Warning
This plugin directly reads and writes another process's memory. It can crash games and cause other issues. Use at your own risk.

ddordie/newfreedeck-arm64.name: NewFreedeck v0.3 — armada (ARM64)
ddordie/newfreedeck-arm64.body:
armada 掌机（ARM64 / Fedora bootc）适配版，基于上游 NewFreedeck v0.3 release 包。

## 适配改动

- `defaults/bin/7zz`、`defaults/bin/aria2c` → **ARM aarch64 原生二进制**（独立子进程，原生执行最快）
- `py_modules/libnewfreedeck_core.so` → **保持 x86_64**（被宿主 PluginLoader 以 ctypes 加载；armada 的 decky 宿主是 x86_64 + FEX，动态库必须同架构）
- `main.py` → 修复 `_auto_extract` 重复触发导致的两个 7zz 并发解压同一目录（IO 翻倍、系统卡顿）
- 启动前缀 → `/usr/libexec/armada/armada-game-launch %command%`（默认开启，设置项改名「自动添加 armada 启动包装」）

## 安装

```bash
sudo rm -rf ~/homebrew/plugins/NewFreedeck
sudo unzip -o NewFreedeck-v0.3-arm64-fixed5.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/
sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader
```

## 说明

- 仅对新导入的游戏注入启动前缀；已导入的需手动改启动选项或重新导入
- 模拟器 AppImage 需自行从天翼云盘下载（插件不附带），且需 arm64 版本

michpalm/showreel.body:
## What's new

- **Smaller delete button:** each recording in Quick Access now has a compact red trash-can button instead of a full-width "Delete" button. It still asks before deleting.
- **No more lost recorders:** if Showreel's backend stopped while GPU Screen Recorder was starting, the recorder kept running and nothing could find it. Showreel now tracks the recorder from launch and finishes it after a reload.

## Install

Download `showreel.zip` below, then Decky → Settings → Developer → **Install plugin from ZIP**.

Requirements are unchanged from 0.1.0: SteamOS in Game Mode with Decky Loader, and the GPU Screen Recorder flatpak.

michpalm/showreel.name: Showreel 0.1.0
michpalm/showreel.body:
First release.

## What it does

- **One button:** Record, then Stop, in the Quick Access menu. Everything on screen is recorded, Quick Access and Decky panels included, to H.264 MP4 at the screen's own resolution and 60 fps (about 5–6 MB per minute at 1080p on the Steam UI). No audio.
- **Files** go to `~/Videos/Showreel/`, and `latest.mp4` always points to the newest one.
- **Download page** (off by default): switch it on and open `http://<device-ip>:8790/` on another device. Tools can fetch `/recordings.json` and `/latest.mp4`. It is read-only.
- **Steam UI only:** Record is unavailable while a game runs, and a game that starts mid-recording stops it. On SteamOS 3.8, stopping a full-size screen capture while a game draws can crash gamescope.
- **Works with [Ambideck](https://github.com/michpalm/ambideck) 1.2.0+**, which steps aside while Showreel records (capture lock described in the README).

## Requirements

SteamOS in Game Mode with Decky Loader, and the GPU Screen Recorder flatpak (`flatpak install flathub com.dec05eba.gpu_screen_recorder`, or Discover in Desktop Mode).

## Install

Download `showreel.zip` below, then Decky → Settings → Developer → **Install plugin from ZIP**.

Tested on a ROG Xbox Ally (RC73YA) with SteamOS 3.8. Nothing in it is device-specific, so it should work on any SteamOS handheld (Steam Deck, ROG Ally, Legion Go…); reports welcome.

nucat176/decky-16x10-fixes.name: v0.1.19-rc.1 — Resonance camera test
nucat176/decky-16x10-fixes.body:
## Camera test for Final Fantasy Resonance

This prerelease tests a possible correction for the image compression or reduced horizontal view reported with v0.1.18 at 1920x1200 on Legion Go 2. It changes the upstream mod's camera policy from preserving vertical field of view to preserving horizontal field of view. The expected result is the original horizontal scene width plus additional scenery above and below. The result has not yet been verified on the device.

HUD constraining stays disabled, the upstream movie correction stays enabled, and the same pinned full-game mod v0.3.0 is used. Only one byte of the mod changes; both original and adjusted hashes are checked before installation.

## Try it

1. Close the game and install `16x10-fixes.zip` from this prerelease through Decky.
2. Open 16:10 Fixes, press **Rescan**, select **Final Fantasy Resonance (Experimental)** and press **Reinstall Fix**. Updating the plugin alone does not replace the game mod.
3. Keep the game at **1920x1200** and SteamOS scaling on **Auto** or **Fit**.
4. Compare the same scene and camera position with v0.1.18. Check the left/right landmarks, extra visibility above/below, and whether characters retain their proportions.

To return to the earlier camera behavior, install the v0.1.18 plugin ZIP and press **Reinstall Fix** again. Both versions keep HUD constraining disabled.

## Validation

Seven backend tests, the Decky build/package, application typechecking with skipLibCheck, and local install/rollback using the actual upstream release ZIP passed. Character proportions, scene framing, HUD, menus, battle transitions and cutscenes still need on-device validation.

## Install and test

2. Close the game, open 16:10 Fixes, and press **Rescan**.
3. Select **Final Fantasy Resonance (Experimental)** and press **Install Fix**.

The plugin attempts to apply `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winmm=n,b" %command%` automatically. If necessary, copy it from **Advanced** into the game's Steam launch options.

## Validation boundary

The build, six backend tests, and local installation/rollback using the actual upstream ZIP passed. Full-game gameplay, HUD, menus, battle transitions, and cutscenes on Legion Go 2/SteamOS still need on-device testing. HUD constraining stays off; the upstream movie correction stays enabled and pre-rendered videos may retain 16:9 black bars.

yifeplayte/rayneo-control.name: RayNeo Control v1.0.0
yifeplayte/rayneo-control.body:
A Decky Loader plugin that controls RayNeo XR glasses from the Steam Deck over USB — no phone app required.

> ### ⚠️ RayNeo GT Max only
>
> Developed and tested against the **RayNeo GT Max (雷鸟 GT Max)** and nothing else.
>
> The protocol is shared across the family, so other RayNeo / FFalcon models may work — but nothing here has been verified on them, the capability gating has only been exercised against one unit's bitmap, and the brightness table is selected by device type. Treat any other model as untested.
>
> If you try it on one, please open an issue with your `tools/rayneo_cli.py caps` output.

## Install

1. Download `RayNeo-Control.zip` below
2. Decky → **Settings → General** → turn on **开发者模式 / Developer mode**
3. Go to the new **开发者 / Developer** tab → **第三方插件 / Third-Party Plugins** → **浏览文件 / Browse** next to **从 ZIP 压缩文件安装插件 / Install Plugin from ZIP File** → pick the zip and confirm
4. Plug the glasses in over USB-C and press **Connect**

Decky hides the ZIP option behind developer mode, so step 2 is required.

No udev rules, no system packages. `plugin.json` declares `"flags": ["root"]` because the glasses' USB node is `0664 root:root` and a plugin running as `deck` cannot open it.

## What it does

| Section | Controls |
| --- | --- |
| 连接 Connection | Connect / disconnect, model + firmware readout |
| 显示 Display | 屏幕亮度 brightness, 显示模式 2D/3D, 屏幕尺寸 115 % / 100 % / 85 %, 场景模式 通用/电影/护眼/阅读, 动态画质 SDR / AI-HDR, 色彩增强 |
| 声音 Sound | 音量 volume, 音效 标准/轻语/空间环绕, 导音鳍 Sound Tube |

Every control is gated on the capability bitmap the glasses report, so unsupported options grey out rather than failing a write.

## Notable in this release

* **Both sliders write on every tick**, matching the official app, and brightness commits once at the end of a drag. Median round trip measured at **11 ms**, down from 515 ms in the first working version.
* **The panel never assumes a change landed.** Every silent command is confirmed against the status read-back, and a refusal moves the control back to where the hardware actually is rather than showing the requested value.
* **It recovers on its own.** Three unanswered polls release the handle and it keeps looking for the glasses, so replugging needs no button press — while a disconnect *you* asked for is left alone, not undone.
* **Debug mode** (one switch at the bottom of the panel) hides the diagnostic tools and silences the per-frame trace, the startup protocol tables and the timing notes. Errors and warnings are never silenced.

## Known limitations

* **Brightness tops out at 12 steps while the panel may reflect fewer.** The glasses stop reporting brightness above the current display strategy mode's band even though the write is accepted — the same reason the official app's slider appears to fall back on its own. The mode is not on the wire, so the ceiling is fixed rather than learned.
* **阅读 (reading) mode refuses colour enhancement in hardware** and reports success anyway; the toggle is greyed out there rather than trusting the read-back.
* **`0x0D` (brightness save) is sent but has never been observed to do anything** on this hardware. It is kept because the official app sends it.
* **Refresh rate is not exposed** — the protocol supports 60/120 Hz and the device reports 120 Hz, but the official app offers no such setting on this model, so neither does the plugin.
* Changing 3D mode briefly blanks the glasses and shows a split screen. That is the device's normal behaviour.

## How it was built

The official Android app (雷鸟 XR 眼镜 v2.1.2) was decompiled and the native library carrying all device traffic, `libFFalconXRServer.so`, was reverse-engineered to recover the USB framing and the full command set. Nothing from the app is redistributed; this is an independent implementation of the wire protocol.

The command table was recovered twice by two independent methods (raw disassembly and Ghidra's decompiler), which agree on all 33 opcodes. The write-up is in [`docs/PROTOCOL.md`](docs/PROTOCOL.md), and the engineering notes behind the behaviour above are in [`docs/NOTES.md`](docs/NOTES.md).

## Requirements

* Steam Deck with Decky Loader
* RayNeo GT Max glasses

m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper.name: v1.2.1 – First release
m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper.body:
**Xbox Wireless Helper**, a Decky Loader plugin that makes the Xbox Wireless Adapter behave on Bazzite, SteamOS, and other Linux gaming setups.

## ✨ Features

- **Fixes the controller after sleep.** No more unplugging and replugging the adapter. After every wake, the plugin waits for USB to settle and resets the adapter in software. If the gentle reset fails, it escalates: re-authorize → USB port power-cycle → USB reset.
- **Wake the PC with the Xbox button.** One toggle enables wake on the adapter, its hubs, the USB controller, and the matching firmware (ACPI) wake entries. It's re-applied after every reset and replug, and your original settings are restored when you turn it off or uninstall.
- **Pairing button.** Put the adapter into pairing mode from the Quick Access menu, without reaching behind the PC.
- **Live status.** The panel shows the adapter, connected controllers and how each is connected (adapter / Bluetooth / cable), wake status, and the last reset result.
- **Keep USB powered in sleep** (last resort). Switches sleep to s2idle for boards that cut USB power in deep sleep. ⚠️ May keep the fans running.

**Requirements:** Decky Loader, and the `xone` driver for the adapter (default on Bazzite). Pairing and wake-from-sleep need `xone`.

## ⚠️ Known limitations

- Bluetooth-connected controllers can't wake the PC on Linux. Use the adapter or a cable.
- "Keep USB powered in sleep" (s2idle) keeps most desktop boards in their "on" power state, so the fans keep spinning.
- BIOS options vary a lot between manufacturers. Please open an issue with your board model if wake doesn't work for you.

Tested on Bazzite with the Xbox Wireless Adapter for Windows.

## What's Changed
* Bump @types/react-dom from 19.1.1 to 19.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper/pull/7


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper/compare/v1.0.0...v1.2.1

# Install SCopy on a Steam Deck or Steam Machine

SCopy is a [Decky Loader](https://decky.xyz) plugin. Install Decky Loader first if you haven't already.

zacharyqin/power-timeline.name: v0.3.13
zacharyqin/power-timeline.body:
## 0.3.13 — 2026-10-28

### English

- Include daily battery-health history and account-scoped persistent game icons from the preceding development build. Health observations remain independent of rolling timeline retention; saved icons can be reused after their original artwork disappears.
- Archive native icons served from Steam's current `community_assets/images/apps` path as well as its older public-image path. Keep the fixed Steam download origin, exact AppID/image-hash checks and account-scoped stored bytes. Fixes visible game icons not being saved for later reuse.
- Keep the battery-health plot at a fixed 132-pixel height, with coordinates sized to its actual width and fewer date labels in narrow layouts. Prevent large displays from enlarging the chart and its text while preserving real history, range selection and scrubbing.
- Share explicit runtime/source manifests and archive exclusions between local and CI packaging. Exclude authoring GLB/projection files, caches and debug output; preserve runtime images, notices and matching Decky API rebuild sources. Validate source freshness and publish only the exact generated runtime/source ZIP pair.
- Replace the three hardware PNG layers with lossless WebP, preserving visible pixels and transparency. Keep only executable code, WebP assets, Loader metadata and essential offline notices in the install ZIP; provide matching sources separately with a version-specific download link. Disable release source maps and exclude documentation, old PNGs and duplicate license files from the runtime package.

### 中文

- 本版本一并交付此前开发版的每日电池健康度历史与按账户隔离的游戏图标持久缓存。健康度独立于功率历史滚动保留，原图来源失效后可回退已存图标。
- 补齐 Steam 当前 `community_assets/images/apps` 原生图标路径，同时保留旧公共图片路径支持。下载仍限定固定 Steam 来源、精确 AppID／图片哈希与账户隔离，修复图标已显示却未保存、无法在来源消失后复用的问题。
- 健康度图表固定为 132 像素高，按实际宽度绘制坐标，窄布局减少日期刻度，避免大屏把图表与文字一起放大；保留真实历史、范围选择和游标操作。
- 本地与 CI 共用明确的运行包／源码包清单和排除规则，去除设计 GLB／投影文件、缓存和调试产物；保留运行图片、许可声明与匹配的 Decky API 重建源码。打包前校验源码归档是否最新，构建产物只上传本次生成的安装／源码 ZIP 对。
- 三张硬件 PNG 图层改为无损 WebP，保留可见像素与透明度。安装 ZIP 仅保留运行代码、WebP、Loader 元数据与必要离线许可内容；匹配源码单独交付并提供对应版本下载入口。关闭发布 source map，排除运行包中的文档、旧 PNG 和重复许可文件。

zacharyqin/power-timeline.name: v0.3.11
zacharyqin/power-timeline.body:
## 0.3.11 — 2026-10-27

### English

- Use Steam's current library display names for Steam and non-Steam games across QAM, history, session details, timeline labels, legends and tooltips. Keep recorded names when library metadata is unavailable; never reinterpret a user-chosen title as a generated placeholder.
- Share one icon renderer across those views. Respect the icon currently selected in Steam shortcut properties before stale grid files; for Steam games prefer the current account's latest custom artwork before the store icon. Use a gamepad only when no image is available. Decode shortcut SteamGameIds exactly for presentation without changing stored game IDs or merging histories.
- Read saved ICO and shortcut image files when Steam cannot serve them. Scope lookups to the active account, reject non-images and special files, bound image reads, and keep filesystem work off the recorder's event loop. Refresh visible metadata and omit unchanged image payloads.
- Preserve recording, session identity, energy totals, coverage, database schema and hardware settings. This development build does not authorize a commit, push, tag or public release.

### 中文

- QAM、游戏历史、会话详情、时间线标签、图例和提示统一使用 Steam 当前资料库显示名，Steam 与非 Steam 游戏同样处理。资料不可用时保留已记录名称，不把用户自选的标题误当作生成占位名。
- 上述入口共用图标组件：非 Steam 游戏优先使用 Steam 快捷方式属性中当前选定的图标，避免旧 grid 图片反压新选择；Steam 游戏优先使用当前账户最新的自定义图片，再回退商店图标。无可用图片时才显示手柄占位。完整快捷方式 SteamGameId 精确转换仅供展示查询，不修改历史游戏 ID，也不合并历史。
- 补齐 Steam 无法直接提供的 ICO 和快捷方式图片读取；限定当前账户，拒绝非图片和特殊文件，限制单图读取体积，文件工作移至录制事件循环之外。可见资料持续刷新，图片未变时不重复传输内容。
- 保留录制、会话身份、能量、覆盖时长、数据库 schema 和硬件设置；本开发版本不代表获准 commit、push、打 tag 或公开发布。

zacharyqin/power-timeline.name: v0.3.10
zacharyqin/power-timeline.body:
## 0.3.10 — 2026-10-27

### English

- Read saved names for user-added non-Steam games from Steam's binary `shortcuts.vdf`. Resolve both the unsigned shortcut AppID and its full SteamGameId as exact strings, preserving the recorded identity rather than merging histories or guessing a title from an executable.
- Locate the player's Steam directory through `DECKY_USER_HOME`, not the root backend's `HOME`. Refresh changed shortcut catalogs while the frontend is closed and backfill names for already-recorded games, including games first observed after backend startup.
- Keep the last complete catalog during a partial rewrite; do not choose arbitrarily between conflicting account names. Removing a shortcut does not erase a name already stored in history. Metadata alone never creates a running game or session.
- Preserve sample/session identities, observations, Wh and coverage. No database schema, chart layout or frontend naming workaround is added.

### 中文

- 从 Steam 二进制 `shortcuts.vdf` 读取用户添加的非 Steam 游戏名称；用精确字符串同时匹配无符号快捷方式 AppID 与完整 SteamGameId，保留原记录身份，不合并历史，也不凭可执行文件猜游戏名。
- 通过 `DECKY_USER_HOME` 查找玩家的 Steam 目录，不再误用 root 后台的 `HOME`。前端关闭时仍检查快捷方式目录变化，为已有记录回填名称，也覆盖后台启动后才首次记录的游戏。
- Steam 部分重写配置时保留上一份完整名称目录；不同账户的名称冲突不任意选取。删除快捷方式不会清除历史中已保存的有效名称；只有名称元数据不会产生运行游戏或会话。
- 保留样本／会话身份、观测记录、Wh 与覆盖时长，不改数据库 schema、图表布局，也不增加前端猜名分支。

zacharyqin/power-timeline.name: v0.3.9
zacharyqin/power-timeline.body:
## 0.3.9 — 2026-10-27

### English

- Enforce `max_points` for both bucketed timelines and unbucketed/session-detail queries. Keep real first/last samples and retain boundaries and per-segment extrema when they fit; if the required set exceeds the budget, select across the whole range and conservatively separate samples across omitted segment, NULL or explicit-break boundaries. Never truncate the range or create synthetic samples.
- Decode only the selected plot samples after scanning typed columns. Filter integration rows with `system_start_w IS NOT NULL` and select only the columns used by clipping; retain zero power, the original interpolation and accumulation order. Events, energy and covered time are independent of the plot cap.
- Keep sampling, schema, read-only snapshot isolation, history-worker locking, frontend caching and event SQL unchanged. Include the regression tests in the matching-source archive.
- Local package only: this build does not install or replace the Steam Deck package, or authorize a commit, push, tag or public release.

### 中文

- 分桶时间线与未分桶／会话详情查询均严格执行 `max_points`。保留真实首尾，预算足够时保留边界与分段极值；必要点集超过上限时，覆盖整个范围选点，并在被省略的分段、NULL 或明确断点处保守断线。不截断时间范围，不生成虚构样本。
- 扫描类型化列后，仅解码最终选中的曲线样本。积分查询先筛选 `system_start_w IS NOT NULL`，只取裁剪所需列；保留零功率、原有插值与累加顺序。事件、能量与覆盖时长独立于曲线点数上限。
- 采样、schema、只读快照隔离、历史 worker 锁、前端缓存和事件 SQL 不变。对应源码包一并包含回归测试。
- 仅生成本地安装包：本次不安装或覆盖 Steam Deck 上的包，也不代表获准 commit、push、打 tag 或公开发布。

zacharyqin/power-timeline.name: v0.3.8
zacharyqin/power-timeline.body:
## 0.3.8 — 2026-10-26

### English

- Add **Settings → Open-source licenses**, with native component lists, details and an offline full-text reader. Preserve the current reading level and focus across page visits; Back returns one level at a time. Localize the interface in all six languages without translating the license originals.
- Center license-row chevrons against the complete title-and-description row, including settings and document entries, without changing text layout or navigation.

Distinguish bundled Decky API and React Icons, Font Awesome SVG and Feather artwork, host/system-provided interfaces, and the Valve-CAD-derived hardware illustration. 3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.15 — 引擎环境不再被 PyInstaller 遮蔽
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
## 症状

引擎正常启动、界面能开，但配置管理的**同步**失败：

```
读取远端快照失败：git clone https://github.com/<user>/<repo>.git 失败 (exit 128)
… /_MEI0000054cWWSwqE/libssl.so.3: version `OPENSSL_3.5.0' not found
   (required by /usr/lib/libcurl.so.4) …
致命错误：remote helper 'https' aborted session
```

## 根因

SteamOS 的 `/usr/bin/flatpak` 是 PyInstaller 打包的，它把自带的旧 OpenSSL 解包到 `$TMPDIR/_MEIxxxxxx/`。Decky 服务进程的 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 指向这种目录，于是**所有子进程**（node、git、git-remote-https）都优先从那里加载 libssl，版本不够就 abort。

v0.1.6 修过一模一样的坑，但只修了「启动浏览器的环境」（`_gui_env`）；**启动引擎的环境**（`_build_env`）仍然原样继承 `os.environ` —— 引擎活了，它下面的 git 死了。

## 修法

清洗提到最外层统一入口 `_sanitize_inherited_env()`，引擎与浏览器两条 spawn 路径都走它。比 v0.1.6 更克制也更彻底：

- `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` / `LD_PRELOAD` 里**只删**指向 `_MEI…` 的条目和已不存在的目录，**你手动设的合法值会被保留**（v0.1.6 是整条丢掉）
- 整条都被遮蔽时**移除变量**而不是留空（空条目在加载器语义里等于「当前目录」）
- `TMPDIR` 只在「是 `_MEI` 目录 / 不可写 / 不存在」时才换成 `/tmp`

## 升级

下载下方的 `dsh-decky.zip` 覆盖安装，然后**重启引擎**（插件改的是启动环境，不重启不生效）。

## 应急（不升级也能救）

```bash
env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH TMPDIR=/tmp <原来的 dsh 启动命令> --profile web --no-open --port 3080
```

或把配置管理的同步通道从 **Git** 换成 **Gist / WebDAV** —— 那两条走 Node 的 HTTPS，根本不 spawn `git`。

## 测试

`tests/run_tests.py` 新增 8 项 env 清洗回归检查，全量 95 项通过。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.14 — 方案C：注册为游戏库条目（游戏模式内可见）
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机定案（v0.1.12/13）：外部浏览器确实能启动，但窗口开在桌面显示 :0 上，游戏模式看不到——gamescope 只合成自己的 Wayland 画面，X11 客户端无法盖在游戏之上。方案 B 在游戏模式结构性走不通。

方案 C 把启动交给 Steam 自己：由 gamescope 会话内启动浏览器，窗口自然得到合成。

- 后端 prepare_nonsteam()：生成稳定的启动脚本，并把会轮换的 token URL 写入 last-url.txt（Steam 注册时会快照 Exec 目标，URL 必须放在脚本外）；引擎每打印新 token 都自动刷新该文件
- 前端通过 SteamClient.Apps.AddShortcut 注册（先移除同名条目保持幂等），API 不可用时给出手动「添加非 Steam 游戏」的准确路径
- 有意不手写 shortcuts.vdf：那是 Steam 自己的二进制格式，写错会毁掉用户整个游戏库

用法：游戏模式 → 插件 → 添加为游戏库条目（方案 C）→ 回首页启动「DSH Browser」。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.13 — 分离启动延迟回读诊断
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机确认：v0.1.12 的 X11 路线让 Firefox 窗口成功开出来了——但开在桌面模式的 :0 显示上，游戏模式（gamescope）看不到它。X11 窗口无法进入 gamescope 合成，方案 B 的外部浏览器在游戏模式里天生受限。

本版为诊断增强：flatpak 交接启动后 6 秒回读——pgrep 应用真实进程存活状态 + 读取继承的 stderr + 记录实际 DISPLAY，写入面板日志。用于区分"活在别的显示"与"交接后崩溃"。（方案 C：注册为 Non-Steam 游戏由 Steam/gamescope 直接启动，下一版。）

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.12 — 强制 X11：Wayland 注入导致 GTK seat 崩溃
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机日志显示 Firefox 已能启动（org.mozilla.firefox:2），随即死在 `gdk_seat_get_keyboard: assertion 'GDK IS SEAT (seat)' failed`（附 minidump）。原因：插件注入了 WAYLAND_DISPLAY=gamescope-0，但 flatpak 沙箱内的浏览器够不着 gamescope 的 Wayland socket，GTK 拿到空 seat 直接断言崩溃。

本版强制走 X11（XWayland :0，与 Steam 内置浏览器同一显示路线）：移除 WAYLAND_DISPLAY、设 GDK_BACKEND=x11、MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND=0。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.11 — 接受 flatpak run 的 fork 语义（退出码0=成功）
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机日志：这台机器的 flatpak 不认识 --nofork（未知选项）。不再对抗 fork：flatpak run 派生应用后自己退 0 被判定为启动成功（detached_ok 候选专属语义），仅非 0 退出才换下一个候选。

注意：「关闭外部窗口」对分离启动的应用用 pkill -f 按 app id 精确匹配——若桌面上同时开着另一个 flatpak Firefox，会一并被关闭（如实声明的已知限制）。

flightdan/opti2xmx.name: Opti2XMX 0.3.2
flightdan/opti2xmx.body:
# Opti2XMX 0.3.2

- Restore the four-position frame-generation multiplier slider (native, 2×, 3×, 4×) and expand advanced settings by default for each selected game. A manual collapse is retained during the plugin session.
- Identify the current super-resolution component as XeSS 2.0.2 and the existing experimental frame-generation output as XeSS 3. This labels the existing SDK 3 path; it does not add a second super-resolution runtime or a native-game frame-generation override.
- Remove the persistent auto-save descriptions beneath upscaling and multiplier controls. After a successful actual settings change, a brief notice asks the user to restart the game. Failed saves keep their error; unchanged values do not show a restart notice.
- Harden stable OptiScaler archive and extracted-payload verification, and remove implicit development-path dependency discovery. This release retains existing game-file ownership, recovery and local-only source rules.

## Validation and limits

The final source and standalone archive are tested separately from the installer integration. XeSS frame generation and multipliers remain experimental: a saved request or an FPS overlay alone does not prove the actual interpolation count. Prior testing used Cyberpunk 2077 on Arc B390 with ray tracing off; the final 0.3.2 UI/game combination has not yet received physical-device acceptance. FSR 4.1.2 Lite XMX still requires the user's locally supplied, verified model archive.

## 中文摘要

## Build verification

- Source commit: `727bf64e7264565ad81ddf2ee1b54e30ceb2062a`.
- GitHub Linux CI passed frozen dependency installation, typecheck, build, frontend scenarios, all 245 Python tests, and standalone packaging.
- The 37 members of the uploaded ZIP match the independently generated CI archive byte for byte. Archive size: 1,487,450 bytes. SHA-256: `67e0b49feb1b6866cb40f3fced5b6c7103348d699b86a9ace5ab63642e9fc160`.
- This does not claim final-version game or hardware acceptance.

flightdan/opti2xmx.name: Opti2XMX 0.3.1 — local package reuse and per-game setup
flightdan/opti2xmx.body:
# Opti2XMX 0.3.1

Opti2XMX now follows the complete game setup sequence rather than showing controls before their prerequisites are ready.

- Opening the plugin refreshes game/component state and prefers the running supported Steam game. Manual game choices survive Steam's native menus. The redundant Refresh button is removed.
- Games with multiple executable candidates show the required executable choice first. Installation, XMX and Opti controls appear after a valid choice. A missing or incomplete Opti installation does not show the overlay control. Record-driven recovery remains accessible when a failed installation needs rollback or launch confirmation.
- Fresh installation, repair and managed installation share the same Opti 10 preview / 0.9.4 / 0.7.9 target selector. Current and target versions are identified separately. Choosing a target does not install it.
- When a matching archive is already cached, **Install from local package** is the first/default source. The cache is shared across games and is compatible with archives supplied by a Boiler device package. An explicit local source never silently falls back to the network. When absent, the first installation can download and retain the archive; later installations reuse it.
- An explicit installation can temporarily restore an active XMX setup, install and confirm Opti, then re-enable XMX through the freshly detected Opti route. The operation survives Quick Access unmount/remount. Errors retain the actual state and recovery actions; reopening does not retry an operation automatically. Migration continues to preserve adopted files/settings.
- Upscaling, frame-generation, multiplier and GPU selections save automatically. A running game is refused with an exit-game message, and the saved selection stays visible. Native / 2× / 3× / 4× multiplier choices save only the confirmed value. Reset, undo and interrupted-settings recovery remain available.
- Version installation resets upscaling to XeSS and frame generation to native control. Select FSR again afterward to prepare/enable its existing XMX path. FSR 4.1.2 Lite XMX still requires the user's exact locally imported model archive; model DLLs and private caches are not distributed.

## Validation

- TypeScript checking, production build and all 23 frontend scenario groups passed. These include fresh and managed installs, executable gating, native menus, active-XMX install ordering, fresh route selection, duplicate-action protection, missing local cache refusal, interrupted installation rollback and launch confirmation.
- All 230 Python fixture tests passed in an isolated Linux directory. They exercise read-only cache discovery, cached source reuse across managers, local-only cache misses without network work, settings preflight and version reset behavior.
- On the test device, all three existing original Opti archives were used with network access prohibited inside the test process. A second pass also prohibited extraction and successfully reused all prepared payloads. No game installation or game settings were changed by this cache check.
- The existing Boiler local OXP3 package's three archive targets, byte sizes and hashes were checked against the plugin's cache contract. The pinned runtime and ordinary public CPU payload remain separate.
- Independent review found and verified fixes for stale snapshot reads, concurrent actions, recovery hidden behind executable selection and an explicit-local choice silently becoming a network source.
- The final new UI/full installation sequence has automated coverage; final physical game installation and native UI acceptance are not claimed. Earlier development candidates do not establish acceptance of this exact release.

This release does not add support for unsupported games/GPUs, prove new performance gains, or distribute the user's FSR model. Existing Opti 10/FSR compatibility limits remain documented in [FSR XMX](FSR_XMX.md).

## 中文摘要

- 先确认游戏程序，再显示安装与设置；未装好 Opti 时隐藏覆盖层入口。
- 新装、修复和已安装入口使用同一套三个版本选项；有本地包时默认“从本地安装”，各游戏共用缓存。
- XMX 开启时安装会自动处理临时关闭与恢复；失败保留恢复入口，不在重开时偷偷重试。
- 设置选完自动保存；游戏运行时提示先退出，并保留已保存选项。
- 23 组前端回归及 230 项 Linux 测试通过；三份实机缓存包的禁止联网与二次直接复用验证通过。最终实机新界面和完整游戏安装验收未完成，详见上述验证边界。


Source commit: `c99638e3768ddd50326eade01cdd024031096c92`

Standalone ZIP SHA-256: `d2d6b3ccdfd73c8676450dcce5312330db861276e1ab2062e56efb0ac5043fea`

flightdan/opti2xmx.name: Opti2XMX 0.3.0 — XeSS / FSR 4.1.2 Lite XMX
flightdan/opti2xmx.body:
# Opti2XMX 0.3.0

The existing **Upscaling output** control now offers **XeSS** and **FSR 4.1.2 Lite XMX** while XMX is enabled. XeSS remains the default. Selecting FSR prepares the pinned OptiScaler 10 preview, enables the per-game XMX bridge, and saves the selected output for the next Steam launch. GPU identity remains Intel.

FSR requires the user's original `FSR-4.1.2-Lite-XMX-OptiClick-0.6.zip`. The file picker imports and verifies that exact build locally. Its upscaler, weights and NVIDIA DLL are not distributed in this plugin, the Windows installer or maintenance packages. See [FSR XMX](FSR_XMX.md) for the supported archive and limitations.

The public plugin includes the source and licenses of a small LZMS decompression adapter and wimlib. It uses a private import name and does not replace Wine's Cabinet DLL. The per-game compiler adapter corrects the verified FSR PRE kernel's root-table metadata while preserving its machine code. Other kernels retain their original compiler path.

Turning XMX off returns to XeSS rather than leaving the XMX-only FSR model selected. Per-game preparation, injection toggles, settings undo and uninstall keep recoverable originals. Existing mixed manual Opti 0.9.4 installations can be adopted only when the core matches the exact official release; existing companion files are backed up as user originals.

## Validation

- 222 backend tests, frontend behavior checks, TypeScript checking and production build passed.
- The decompression adapter decoded all six real resource packs (136,704,915 output bytes) identically to the reference on Windows and Proton Experimental. Malformed framing, missing dependencies and handle lifecycle checks passed. Repeated builds produced identical DLL hashes.
- SteamOS 3.10 / Intel Arc B390 / the published patched Mesa 26.1.2 runtime / Proton Experimental / Cyberpunk 2077 2.31: FSR completed the 64.20-second benchmark at 30.06 average FPS; switching back to XeSS completed 64.24 seconds at 30.17 FPS. Output was 1920×1200, FSR input 1280×800, frame generation and ray tracing off. Both runs used the managed game setup and showed no device-lost exception.
- Real uninstall restored all 98 original tracked game files byte-for-byte, the original Steam launch options and original game settings. The new installation was then restored with XeSS selected and XMX off.

This is a compatibility feature tested on the configuration above. The two single runs establish that both paths complete; they do not establish a performance advantage. Other GPUs, games, model builds, ray tracing and frame generation combinations remain unverified.

Installer and maintenance delivery retain the separate published XeSS runtime and the two stable Opti archives, and add the pinned `nightly-20261025` Opti 10 archive. FSR model import remains a local user action.

enjihn/steamos-ddplus-decky.name: SteamOS DD+ 1.0.0-beta.1
enjihn/steamos-ddplus-decky.body:
# SteamOS DD+ 1.0.0-beta.1

This first public prerelease packages the accepted SteamOS Dolby Digital Plus
runtime as a Decky Loader plugin.

## Included

- Optional DD+ 5.1 and DD+ 7.1 HDMI/eARC profiles.
- Direct switching among stock Stereo, stock 5.1 LPCM, stock 7.1 LPCM, DD+ 5.1,
  and DD+ 7.1.
- Live ELD and PipeWire device discovery; no hard-coded HDMI card or PCM.
- Transactional, user-local installation and removal with exact-file ownership,
  crash recovery, and stock-profile preservation checks.
- The accepted x86_64 E-AC-3 runtime, exact corresponding FFmpeg source,
  third-party notices, and SHA-256 checksums.

## Validation completed

- 47 codec, IEC 61937, channel-map, and reference tests.
- Complete legacy deployment, activation, rollback, and recovery test suite.
- Decky backend transaction tests covering all five selections, interrupted
  recovery, exact rollback, and preservation of unrelated defaults.
- TypeScript typecheck and production Rollup build.
- x86_64 packaged-runtime loader and codec self-test in the pinned SteamOS
  builder.

## Prerelease boundary

The bundled DD+ runtime is the already accepted Steam Machine build. The new
portable Decky discovery and installer have automated Linux coverage but have
not yet completed a clean-machine hardware acceptance run across multiple
HDMI/eARC endpoints. Back up important configuration and use the plugin's
Remove action before uninstalling Decky itself.

This independent project is not certified, licensed, endorsed, or supported by
Dolby Laboratories or Valve. Review the repository licensing and third-party
notices before redistribution.

acestronautical/decky-protonvpn.name: Proton VPN for Decky (Unofficial) v0.1.0
acestronautical/decky-protonvpn.body:
# Proton VPN for Decky (Unofficial) v0.1.0

Initial experimental prerelease of an independent Decky integration for Proton VPN.
Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Proton AG.

## Install

Download **decky-protonvpn-v0.1.0.zip**, not GitHub's source archives. In Decky settings, select **Manual Plugin Install > Load from ZIP file**.

**Upgrading from a development build:** remove the old Decky plugin named **Proton VPN** first, then install **Proton VPN (Unofficial)**. Do not uninstall the Proton VPN Flatpak or remove its account data. This avoids two plugin copies controlling the same VPN.

## Included

- Native Connection, Settings, and Account tabs with controller navigation.
- Fast NetworkManager-only connection viewing, Quick Connect, country selection, and disconnect.
- Encrypted sign-in, verified account-name display, and confirmed sign-out.
- Kill-switch controls with disconnected-state guards, NetShield, VPN Accelerator, and Moderate NAT.
- Confirmed user-scoped Proton VPN Flatpak installation when missing, with resumable panel status and compatibility verification.
- Shared operation coordination across panel remounts and guarded, non-destructive keyring access.

## Verification and Limits

- 166 automated tests, TypeScript checking, and packaging verified locally.
- Earlier on-device connection, disconnection, authentication, and IPv4 routing checks passed; these are not comprehensive leak or security certification.
- Live first-install testing, reboot/session-transition durability, and comprehensive IPv6/DNS leak testing remain outstanding.
- Unsupported Proton implementations fail closed. Close Proton's desktop GUI before using plugin controls.
- Keep the Deck awake and do not restart Decky during Flatpak installation. Job state survives panel reopening, not backend restart.

## License and Branding

Software remains BSD-3-Clause with inherited attribution preserved. Dependency notices and the custom artwork notice are included in **NOTICE.md** inside the ZIP. The software license does not grant trademark rights. The custom icon is retained as supplied and confirmed for use by the maintainer; it is not presented as an official Proton logo.

SHA-256 checksums are provided in **SHA256SUMS**.

dawoodtogoo2020-code/helixsr-decky-armad.name: HelixSR Adreno 0.5.0: Odin 3 PRAGMATA 2.0 preview
dawoodtogoo2020-code/helixsr-decky-armad.body:
Adds verified HelixSR 2.0 management for PRAGMATA on Odin 3 running Armada Linux: local source registration, adoption, original-FSR/Helix toggles, INT8/wave/network/reactive-mask settings, atomic recovery and protection from legacy V762 actions.

Startup no longer runs a Wine/GPU probe. The H2 path avoids worker-thread shutdown failures observed under Decky/FEX; two final reloads stopped cleanly in 0.1 seconds. Confirmation dialogs now survive the side panel closing.

Validation: 48 frontend tests; 67 relevant native Odin backend tests; 156 general backend tests on x86 Linux. Actual Decky UI toggles, live settings changes, exact restoration, installed file hashes and reloads were checked. See the attached review for measured results and limitations.

A new 30-second gameplay sample at 960x540 Balanced, INT8 on, wave auto, current WinNative driver and 1100 MHz measured about 29.5 base FPS with LSFG off; p99 frame time 190.72 ms. This is not an improvement claim or sustained/image-quality acceptance. LSFG 2x and all original game settings were restored.

This is a scoped prerelease. It accepts only the tested PRAGMATA/provider hashes; it is not general Adreno, Android or HelixSR 3.x support. The ZIP contains no runtime/model DLLs, weights or generated shaders. Build the [official 2.0 provider](https://github.com/lonewolf0622/HelixSR/releases/tag/v2.0.0) locally on the target device and select its fsr3-drop-in folder. The setup/runtime stays unmodified; upstream terms apply.

Install `HelixSR-Decky-Armada-0.5.0-adreno-preview.zip` using Decky Loader's ZIP installation option, then open HelixSR Adreno. Matching source and SHA256SUMS are attached. No source downloads are required for an already qualified installation on this Odin.

Build audit: one acknowledged low-severity, build-only deepmerge advisory has a source-reviewed, exact-path exception with rejection tests and a 28 November 2026 expiry. Build tools are not distributed. See SECURITY.md in the source for the review; all other findings fail CI.

dawoodtogoo2020-code/helixsr-decky-armad.name: HelixSR Decky Armada 0.3.1 Experimental
dawoodtogoo2020-code/helixsr-decky-armad.body:
Free unofficial experimental preview for HelixSR 1.8.0 Model E / V762 on Armada Linux.

**Before downloading:** this plugin requires your own exact private V762 provider, network assets and four shader overrides. It does not download or generate the model. The source tools begin with matching private runtime dumps; a complete ordinary-user asset-to-dump workflow is still missing. Installing the plugin ZIP alone will not produce a working model.

### What's available

- Steam Deck-style status/setup flow, a single enable toggle, Settings and Advanced troubleshooting.
- Scanned DX12 suggestions; managed DX12 records stay visible while they need review. Unsafe actions remain blocked.
- Fresh running-state checks, verified Steam launch readback, interrupted-change repair and configuration preservation.
- Code-only installer, matching complete source, checksums and a public manifest. The original capability probe includes its source and rebuilding instructions.

### Tested state and known issues

Version 0.3.1 installed on the Odin 3 with all 47 files matching and 747 settings-file hashes preserved. Its source baseline is `2ac296be4047c21401ed62719339ab4d5e7ceab8`; [CI passed](https://github.com/dawoodtogoo2020-code/HelixSR-Decky-Armada/actions/runs/38325727097). The public installer preserves every runtime-code byte from that candidate. Six documentation/provenance entries were corrected for publication, so the public ZIP has its own checksum.

PRAGMATA has historical physical Helix and combined LSFG 2x confirmation. This does not establish a fresh cold-start result for the new interface.

**Witcher 3 Remastered v5.01 still flashes black geometry and sometimes whole frames.** Its matched original FSR run was clean. Do not treat this release as a Witcher flicker fix or measured performance improvement. Live Witcher LSFG Off-to-2x acceptance remains pending. Lossless Scaling VK2 is a separate plugin.

Only the Model E / V762 adaptation is covered here. Model E is sourced locally from **DLSS 310.7.0**, not DLSS 3.7. Other models, games, Snapdragon devices and Android GameHub, DeckDroid, GameNative or Thor are unverified.

### Downloads and source

`HelixSR-Decky-Armada-0.3.1.zip` is the Decky installer. `HelixSR-Decky-Armada-0.3.1-source.zip` contains complete application source and rebuild files. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`.

Read the [installation guide](https://github.com/dawoodtogoo2020-code/HelixSR-Decky-Armada/blob/public-preview/ARMADA_INSTALL.md), [known issues](https://github.com/dawoodtogoo2020-code/HelixSR-Decky-Armada/blob/public-preview/RELEASE_STATUS.md), and [separate source transform preview](https://github.com/dawoodtogoo2020-code/HelixSR-Snapdragon-V762).

The release includes no provider DLL, NVIDIA-derived weights/kernels/network pack, compiled shader override or private dump. HelixSR is by lonewolf0622; unofficial adaptation and Decky integration by Blackheart909. [Author permission](https://github.com/lonewolf0622/HelixSR/issues/3#issuecomment-6128425735) applies to the free unofficial adaptation; third-party terms remain separate. Existing licence and source notices are retained.

lakeland97/timeout-decky-plugin.name: v0.2.0 (alpha)
lakeland97/timeout-decky-plugin.body:
Alpha build for real-world field testing on Steam Deck.

## Update (Oct 14): no self-lockout
- Enabling parental controls now REQUIRES a passcode — the previous build could be enabled with none, leaving no unlock path except Desktop-Mode file editing
- Clearing an existing passcode while controls are enabled is now refused (setting a new one stays allowed — that's the recovery path)
- Whitespace-only passcodes are treated as empty; inputs are trimmed end-to-end
- Fixed: a WRONG passcode in the unlock dialog previously closed the dialog and unlocked anyway (backend always refused — the UI lied). It now visibly fails.

## What's new since v0.1.0 (alpha)

**Enforcement (the plugin's reason to exist)**
- Launch-menu "Cancel" and blocked launches (curfew / out of credits / cooldown) now actually stop the game instead of letting it run unlimited
- "Start Full" with insufficient credits is blocked, not swallowed
- Game termination is verified (SIGTERM → rescan → SIGKILL → verify) with a 60s retry loop — a failed kill can no longer end enforcement
- Fair cap/curfew kills are streak-neutral (runaway days still break the streak)

**Crash-safety / low breakage (plugin handles its own errors)**
- Every background task supervised; startup runs in independently guarded stages
- Stale focus AND stale game-limits sessions reconciled at boot (power-off mid-session can't cause boot-time modals, toast spam, or pre-outage kills)
- Corrupt settings.json restored from an automatic .bak snapshot; full read-boundary type sanitizer; all settings mutations serialized behind a lock
- Frontend: Steam callback wrapped, dismount hardened, promise hygiene, listener lifecycle balanced — SharedJSContext stays intact

**Security / parental controls**
- Passcode stored as salted SHA-256 (household-grade, honestly labeled)
- Locked users can no longer bypass protections through update_settings, import, or factory reset; raw settings RPCs privatized

**First-run UX**
- Installed-games picker list with search, curfew day-mask UI, in-game overlay badge (remaining time / credits / curfew)
- Backup paths contained (~/Documents, ~/Downloads) with clear refusal messages; custom-sound traversal blocked

**Tester kit**

venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.name: Gleipnir 0.2.1
venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.body:
The battery clamp now writes 100000 µA (100 mA) instead of 0 (Armada's `constant_charge_current`) or 1000 (the fork's `charge_control_limit`), after review feedback on armada-os/armada#677 that values that low are below the safe minimum for the Thor and can upset less intelligent chargers.

**Re-run the safety test after updating.** The verification marker stores the clamp value, so an existing marker (`value=0`) no longer arms the daemon until `gleipnir --test --run` passes again.

Tested on one Thor (Armada kernel 7.2.6, 2026-10-24): with the 100000 clamp the charging current fell from 4.5 A to 12-29 mA, then charging resumed after release; the test passed. Not verified: the 0.2-5 W wattage fluctuation the reviewer described (the test measures current, not wattage), the clamp holding at 80 %, and other chargers or builds.

Also in this release: opt-in debug logging (`GLEIPNIR_DEBUG=1`), the FEX kernel-detection fix and the sleep-clamp hold fix from the changelog. The zip has a single top-level `gleipnir/` folder.

venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.name: Gleipnir 0.2.0
venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.body:
Adds the sleep clamp and its setting to Gleipnir, the 80 % battery charge ceiling for the AYN Thor on Armada OS.

**New since 0.1.0**
- The cap now holds through native sleep. Armada's native sleep freezes the daemon, so a Thor that slept at 78 % on a charger woke at 88 %. `gleipnir-sleep.service` clamps just before the suspend.
- A setting, in the Decky panel and as `gleipnir --set-sleep-floor N`: always hold the cap (default; the Thor then does not charge while asleep), hold from 70 % up, or off. The panel shows Armada's current sleep type and hides the setting in fake sleep, where the daemon keeps running.
- A watchdog fix: a game draining the battery with the status still reading Charging no longer disarms the cap.

**Tested on one Thor only** (Armada `20261006.9c7dd3e`, kernel 7.2.6, 2026-10-08): clamp at 80 %, held through a game, charger swaps and sleeps at 60, 76, 79 and 80 %, release at 77 %, charging resumed. Other builds are untested. It starts in watch-only mode and does nothing to charging until its built-in safety test (`gleipnir --test --run`, charger plugged in) passes on your kernel. Read `docs/evidence.md` and `docs/safety.md` first.

The zip has a single top-level `gleipnir/` folder (Decky plugin layout). Not affiliated with AYN or Armada.

venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.name: Gleipnir 0.1.0

Below 70 % on a charger the Thor still charges while asleep and can pass the cap. Other builds are untested. ## Store and catalog fixes

- Top Up recognizes the current Steam Store navigation and skips hidden desktop containers. It follows responsive navigation changes and includes Steam controller activation metadata.

- When Steam does not supply an email, catalog purchase now asks for an address before continuing through the original checkout. Cancellation creates no order. Other purchase failures receive useful messages instead of the generic alert.
- Submitted purchases are never automatically retried.

### Validation

41 Node tests, 40 Python tests, TypeScript, production build and both Chromium checks passed. Real original framework/checkout tested with mock service responses: no email creates zero orders, explicit email continuation creates exactly one. ZIP contents and SHA256 verified.

Install **SteamBooster-Decky-v0.1.6.zip** with Decky, then reconnect SteamBooster and reopen the store/catalog page.

Physical Steam Deck validation remains required for the native keyboard, Game Mode navigation and provider QR/payment flow. No real payments were made. This release is marked as a preview until those device checks are confirmed.

bradleysharp/amethyst-deploy-decky.name: v0.1.0
bradleysharp/amethyst-deploy-decky.body:
First release of **Amethyst Deploy**, a Decky Loader plugin for running [Amethyst Mod Manager](https://github.com/ChrisDKN/Amethyst-Mod-Manager) from Gaming Mode on the Steam Deck, using only the controller. No Desktop Mode needed.

This is an early release: it works on a Deck, but some flows have only been tested on a development machine (see below).

## What it does

- **Quick Access menu:** pick a game and profile, then **Deploy & Play**, **Deploy only** or **Restore vanilla**. It can also install or update Amethyst itself.
- **Mods tab:** turn mods on and off (A), move them (X, then the D-pad, then A), and uninstall them (Y).
- **Load order tab** (games with plugin files): plugin order, missing-master warnings, and **Sort with LOOT**.
- **Get mods tab:**
  - **Nexus Mods:** browse and search. Premium accounts install in one press. Free accounts open the file's page in Steam's browser and press Slow download once; the mod installs when the download finishes.
  - **Thunderstore:** browse, search and install, including dependencies.
  - **Other sites:** any mod archive saved to Downloads can be installed.
- **Downloads tab:** install any archive in `~/Downloads`.
- **Installer options:** FOMOD and BAIN installers show their options as controller pages.
- **Setup tab:** finds installed games from Steam, Heroic, Unifideck, Lutris, Faugus, Bottles and non-Steam shortcuts. It checks each game's folder, and has a controller folder picker for anything it can't find. Profiles can be created here too.

## Requirements

- Steam Deck (SteamOS) with [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader).
- Amethyst Mod Manager's Flatpak. If it's missing, the plugin offers to install it from the developer's own Flatpak remote.
- For Nexus Mods: a Nexus account. Log in once from the plugin; it opens Nexus's page in Steam's browser.

## Install

1. In Decky: **Settings → General → Developer mode** on.
2. **Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP**, and pick `amethyst-deploy-v0.1.0.zip`.

## Known limitations

- **Logging in to Nexus,** and pressing **Slow download** on a free account, are done on Nexus's own page in Steam's browser with the trackpad. Everything else works with the gamepad alone.
- **mod.io and Steam Workshop** aren't supported yet. Mods from those sites can still be installed from the Downloads tab.
- **Not yet tried on a Deck:** Nexus Premium downloads, BAIN installers, and some focus details (after "Load more" and returning from mod details). Reports welcome.
- Amethyst changes often; this release was built against its source as of October 2026.

Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later, like Amethyst Mod Manager.

1m93/deckyeclipse.name: v0.2.0
1m93/deckyeclipse.body:
More of Sunshine and Moonlight from Gaming Mode: stream profiles, Steam games for other devices, automatic discovery, Tailscale, a network test and backups.

**Install or update:** Decky settings → Developer → *Install plugin from URL*, with the link of `Eclipse-0.2.0.zip` below. Settings are kept.

### Play: stream games from a PC (Moonlight)
- **Stream profiles**: save the current settings under a name (TV, Hotel Wi-Fi...), switch in one step here or in the Quick Access menu, give a host its own profile. Saved profiles can be renamed and deleted.
- *Hosts* and *Stream quality* are one **Streaming** settings page.
- **Network test** (host settings, Y on a host, or the Playing card): delay and stability to the host, this device's Wi-Fi or VPN link, a suggested bitrate and a button to use it.
- **Tailscale**: *Add a host* lists PCs in your tailnet; for a PC added at home, its Tailscale address is saved so the same host streams away from home.

### Share: let other devices stream from this one (Sunshine)
- **Games for other devices**: pick installed Steam games (with their covers) that Moonlight on the other device starts directly. Closing the app also ends the game here.
- **Automatic discovery**: when SteamOS does not let Sunshine announce itself (`avahi::entry_group_new() failed: Not permitted`), Eclipse announces the device, so Moonlight lists it on its own.
- **Sunshine's options** in Settings → Sharing (name, bitrate cap, encoder, codecs, audio, controllers, input, encryption, network) and the common ones in the Share tab, with *Restart now* to apply.
- **Notification when a device wants to pair**; pressing it opens the PIN entry.
- Pairing requests no longer show Moonlight's placeholder name "roth": the device's network name or address is shown, and the name you enter is saved.
- The Sharing card says which device is streaming, as far as the network shows.
- **Turn off on low battery** (10/20/30 %, off by default).
- This device's Tailscale address is shown for streaming from outside.

### General
- **Backup and restore**: profiles, stream and host settings, Sunshine's options and games, to this device or a microSD card / USB drive (survives a SteamOS reinstall). Restore is also offered on the welcome screen.
- New plugin and tab icons; the author is shown in About.

Devices paired before this version may be listed as "Unnamed device": unpair and pair again to name them.

1m93/deckyeclipse.name: v0.1.0
1m93/deckyeclipse.body:
First release of Eclipse: Moonlight and Sunshine for SteamOS Gaming Mode, controller only.

**Install:** Decky settings → Developer → *Install plugin from URL*, with the link of `Eclipse-0.1.0.zip` below.

### Play: stream games from a PC (Moonlight)
- Paired hosts with live status, resume the last game in two presses, Wake-on-LAN (automatic before a stream).
- Add host finds PCs running Sunshine on your network; pairing from Gaming Mode, with the PIN entered on the host automatically when its Sunshine login is saved.
- Quality presets, including *Auto: match display*, per-host presets, host monitor selection.
- Steam library shortcuts per host and app.
- Connection checks per host in *Troubleshooting*.

### Share: let other devices stream from this one (Sunshine)
- **Sunshine for Gaming Mode**: Sunshine's official build set up to stream Gaming Mode without a black picture and without forcing gamescope composition (no extra battery use).
- Off unless you turn it on; *Start automatically* and *Turn off automatically* are options, both off by default.
- See who is streaming from the device and end it from the Quick Access menu; optional notifications.
- Pairing requests show up in the Quick Access menu; Sunshine login can be created automatically.
- Sets a first SteamOS password from Gaming Mode when the device has none.

### Quick Access menu
- Play and Share tabs, pinned, switched with LB/RB; whatever is happening right now (playing, sharing, pairing requests) sits on top.

Known limitation: Sunshine does not report which device is streaming, only how many.

venatrix-ritz/ratatoskr.body:
First tagged build of Ratatoskr (formerly Touch Master): the AYN Thor's bottom AMOLED as a trackpad, keyboard and quick-settings surface, on Armada OS with Decky Loader.

**Tested on one Thor only** (Armada `20261006.9c7dd3e`, kernel 7.2.6). The trackpad, keyboard, quick controls, Pen mode and the Decky panel work there; the optional narrow sudo rule is untested. Read `README.md` for the honest status and `docs/` for details.

**In this release**
- The bottom screen follows the top panel's idle dim: it fades within a few seconds of Steam's dim and returns when the top does or when the bottom is touched. It no longer guesses Steam's timing from input (the physical controller cannot be read by the app).
- Pinch to Zoom and Drag Lock are removed (they were never implemented).
- A first-load installer: `Ratatoskr.zip` carries the driver, the user service and the launcher entries and installs them into the home directory when Decky loads the plugin, so the Armada Store route works. It does not install the optional sudo rule.

**Install**
- Armada Store or manual: unpack `Ratatoskr.zip` (one top-level `thor-input/` folder) into `~/homebrew/plugins/`; Decky loads it.
- From a PC: `scripts/deploy.sh`. Do not mix the two routes on one Thor: after a zip install, run `deploy.sh` once, which removes the leftover `driver/` folder.

Not affiliated with AYN or Armada.

zensenshi/jarngrip.name: JarnGrip 0.10.0
zensenshi/jarngrip.body:
**Spell names and pictures on the number pad, a WoW addon, and a status card.**

- **Your WoW action bars on the number keys.** The new **JarnGrip addon** (in `wow-addon/`, copied into WoW's `Interface/AddOns` by hand) saves what each action bar key holds. By default each number key then shows the name of the spell, item or macro it casts, and a swipe's fan names what that swipe casts. When the pad's copy of your bars is out of date, the addon offers a one-tap **Reload** at login. See the guide to set it up.
- **Number pad icons.** Pick **Icons** under **Number keys show** in Decky, and the numbers become square keys with your own pictures, one for the tap and one for each swipe. With the addon, keys without a picture show the spell's icon or name. **Edit icons…** opens a full-screen page to pick them, with search and **Fill from file names**.
- **A status card.** Tap the clock and battery for the network (Wi-Fi, signal, the Thor's IP address, internet), the battery (time left, watts, health) and the temperatures. A touch anywhere closes it, and it closes by itself after 20 seconds.
- **Icons on WoW's buttons** on the Interface, Target and Utility pages, drawn in the theme's colors.
- **Swipes now go toward their squares:** up for Shift (FFXI: Ctrl) as before, **left** for Ctrl (FFXI: Alt), **down** to cancel. Pictures saved for the old swipe down move to the swipe left.
- **Japanese keyboard bindings for WoW:** `/jarngrip jis` makes the pad's `=` key do what `^` does. Your saved bindings are never changed.
- **A tidier Decky panel**, in sections that open with a tap, and WoW's chat radial in the game's chat colors.
- **Fixes:** swipes keep up with your thumb in game, and Remap a control keeps what you pick again.

**Install or update:** download `JarnGrip-0.10.0.zip`, unzip it, and from the `JarnGrip` folder run `./scripts/install-from-pc.sh armada@THOR_IP`. To show your bars, copy `wow-addon/JarnGrip` into WoW's `Interface/AddOns` folder.

Note: Steam client builds from mid-October 2026 need Decky Loader 3.3.0 or newer; earlier versions crash when the Decky menu opens (Decky issue #988). Decky 3.3.0 is also the first with an official ARM build.

zensenshi/jarngrip.name: JarnGrip 0.9.0
zensenshi/jarngrip.body:
**A Desktop profile, and a Chat radial for WoW and FFXI.**

- **Desktop profile**, for the desktop, the web and anything else that is not a game. Pick **Desktop** under Game in Decky.
  - Two pages, **Edit** and **Browser**, with the usual editing, navigation, browser and window shortcuts, and a **Media** radial. Shortcuts that do harm when repeated, such as Close tab and Paste, send one keystroke per touch.
  - The keyboard has **F1 to F12**, Super and the arrow keys.
  - On the trackpad, **Back**, **Copy**, **Paste** and **Forward** replace the modifiers, and you can **pinch** to zoom. Two fingers still scroll and a two-finger tap still right-clicks.
- **A Chat radial on the Utility page.** Touch **Chat** and slide onto a channel, or tap Chat and then a channel: the chat box opens on it and the pad switches to the keyboard. WoW types the channel's command and never presses Enter; FFXI uses its own shortcuts.
- **Shorter Utility pages**, without the buttons the controller already covers.
- **Two-finger scrolling stops when a finger lifts**, even when the touchscreen loses the lift. Before, it could go on scrolling for 1.5 s.
- **Trackpad sensitivity** has moved up into Appearance and feel, beside the haptics.

**Install or update:** download `JarnGrip-0.9.0.zip`, unzip it, and from the `JarnGrip` folder run `./scripts/install-from-pc.sh armada@THOR_IP`.

Note: Steam client builds from mid-October 2026 need Decky Loader 3.3.0 or newer; earlier versions crash when the Decky menu opens (Decky issue #988). Decky 3.3.0 is also the first with an official ARM build.

zensenshi/jarngrip.name: JarnGrip 0.8.0
zensenshi/jarngrip.body:
**Final Fantasy XI, and a fix for a hot spot on the back of the Thor.** Please update: earlier releases have been withdrawn.

- **The vibration motor no longer stays powered after a buzz.** In Desktop Mode, earlier versions left the bare motor drawing about 1.6 W until the pad closed, and a spot on the back of the device grew too hot to touch. The motor now rests between buzzes. Game Mode was not affected.
- **Final Fantasy XI.** Pick the game in Decky: the pad lays out FFXI's default keys on Menus, Target and Utility pages. Each game keeps its own remapped controls and profiles.
  - The number pad is FFXI's macro palette: swipe up for Ctrl (the upper bar), down for Alt (the lower one).
  - Swipe a party target (Self, Party 1 to 5) right to press Enter after it, so a spell cast on `<stpt>` goes off at once.
  - Macro set up and down change the set once per tap.
- **The AYN button works after a reboot.** It could stay dead until Decky restarted.
- **"Stop the screenshot" no longer takes the controller away** when it applies during boot.

**Install or update:** download `JarnGrip-0.8.0.zip`, unzip it, and from the `JarnGrip` folder run `./scripts/install-from-pc.sh armada@THOR_IP`.

Note: Steam client builds from mid-October 2026 need Decky Loader 3.3.0 or newer; earlier versions crash when the Decky menu opens (Decky issue #988). Decky 3.3.0 is also the first with an official ARM build.

# 🦊 SteamGridDB Kitsune Edition 1.9.0

The first release of the Kitsune Edition: the SteamGridDB plugin you know, now faster, lighter and without the bugs that made Steam act weird. Every change was tested on a real Steam Deck. 🎮

## ⚡ Performance
- 🚀 **2.5x faster to load at boot** (81 ms down to 32 ms on a Steam Deck)
- 📦 **Half the size at startup**: 1.1 MB down to 555 KB, the heavy parts load only when you need them
- 🪶 **Near zero CPU**: 0 ms while idle, about 1 ms over 15 seconds of browsing with square capsules on

## 🐛 Bug fixes
- 🔋 **No more side effects on the rest of Steam**, such as the false "slow charger" warning (#184)
- 🏠 **Home tabs work again** with square or matching capsules: What's New, Friends and Recommended switch normally (#98, #127)
- 🎠 **The recents row no longer jumps back** while you scroll (#127)
- 🔁 **No more constant refreshing** in the Non-Steam tab and collections (#138)
- ⏳ **No more endless loading**: network errors and blocked connections now show a clear message (#128, #134, #178)
- 🖼️ **Non-Steam icons apply instantly**, no Steam restart needed (#53)
- 📁 **Clear errors for read-only folders**, plus download timeouts (#170)
- 🧭 **Steam is found in more places** (Flatpak, Snap and other installs)

## 🎁 New features
- 🏆 **Apply All Official**: set the official capsule, wide capsule, hero, logo and icon in one go, perfect for non-Steam games (#57)
- 🔀 **Use as another type**: open an artwork's details and use it as a capsule, wide capsule, hero or logo (#125)
- 🌍 Updated German and Hungarian translations and new Brazilian Portuguese strings

## 📦 How to install
1. Download **SteamGridDB.zip** below
2. In Decky, open **Settings** and turn on **Developer mode**
3. Open the **Developer** tab and choose **Install Plugin from ZIP File**

It replaces the regular SteamGridDB plugin and keeps your settings. ✅

golddgaro/v-deck.body:
# V-Deck 0.2.0 — Public preview

## Русский

VPN-менеджер для Decky Loader и Steam Deck Gaming Mode.

- Amnezia Premium: импорт подписки и выбор доступной страны.
- Экспериментальный Xray VLESS Reality: клиентский JSON и ссылка в файле.
- Дневные логи, улучшения подключения, маршрутизации, пинга и DNS.
- Обновлённые инструкции RU/EN.

Это предварительная версия. Совместимость со всеми серверами, длительная стабильность
и полная защита от DNS/IPv6-утечек не гарантируются. WireGuard/OpenVPN/Xray и последние
изменения пинга/DNS требуют дополнительной проверки на устройствах.

Для установки: **V-Deck-v0.2.0.zip** → Decky Settings → Developer → установка из ZIP.
Перед обновлением отключите VPN и сохраните исходные профили.
Docker и отдельные VPN-пакеты на Steam Deck не нужны.

[Установка и ограничения](https://github.com/GoldDGaro/V-Deck/blob/v0.2.0/README.md)

## English

Decky Loader VPN manager for Steam Deck Gaming Mode. Adds Amnezia Premium
subscription import/country selection, experimental Xray VLESS Reality import,
daily logs and connection/routing/ping/DNS improvements.

Preview: universal compatibility, long-session stability and complete DNS/IPv6
leak protection are not guaranteed. WG/OpenVPN/Xray and the latest ping/DNS changes
need further device validation.

Install **V-Deck-v0.2.0.zip** through Decky's Developer ZIP installer. Disconnect
and keep original profiles before updating. No Docker or separate VPN packages required.

[Installation and limitations](https://github.com/GoldDGaro/V-Deck/blob/v0.2.0/README.md#english)

## Assets / Файлы

- `V-Deck-v0.2.0.zip`: installer / установщик.
- `V-Deck-v0.2.0-source.zip`: corresponding source, not an installer / исходники.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums / контрольные суммы.

Original code: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Third-party licenses remain separate.
V-Deck is not an official Amnezia application. Never publish subscriptions, private
keys, full configurations or raw logs.

forlarin/deck-doctor.name: Deck Doctor v0.5.0
forlarin/deck-doctor.body:
New: controller layout check.

If a game's saved controller layout has a main button mixed up (for example A sends RB, so nothing on the Deck sends A), the checkup now says so and shows which button is wrong. **Open controller settings** takes you straight to that game's layout, and the guide explains how to switch to a standard template. Steam's own templates and community layouts are left alone.

Found on Assassin's Creed Mirage, where an old saved layout made the game feel like it ignored the A button.

forlarin/deck-doctor.name: Deck Doctor v0.4.1
forlarin/deck-doctor.body: Fix: games using a CheatDeck trainer whose file name has an apostrophe (for example "Assassin's Creed Mirage Trainer - FLiNG.exe") closed after 2 seconds with no log, because Proton can't read the path. Deck Doctor now spots this and offers **Fix the launch options**, which escapes the apostrophe. The trainer file isn't changed. Found and verified on Assassin's Creed Mirage.

forlarin/deck-doctor.name: Deck Doctor v0.4.0
forlarin/deck-doctor.body:
New: freeze detection, suggested by JawessOme.

- **The graphics chip froze**: the checkup reads the Deck's kernel log around the launch and tells you when the GPU hung and reset.
- **The Deck ran out of memory**: shows which program Linux had to close.
- **The game didn't close normally**: Steam saw the game start but never end, which usually means a freeze followed by holding the power button.
- **Force close the game**: while a game is running, close it and everything it started (launcher, Proton, a trainer) from the Quick Access menu. Press twice to confirm.

Each one has a How to fix guide.

forlarin/deck-doctor.name: Deck Doctor v0.3.1
forlarin/deck-doctor.body: Fix: games Steam's library doesn't know (uninstalled games, demos) now show their real name instead of "App 12345". Thanks to Koonga for reporting it.

forlarin/deck-doctor.name: Deck Doctor v0.3.0
forlarin/deck-doctor.body:
## EmuDeck support

Suggested on Reddit: "tell you what emulator isn't working". For games added by EmuDeck, Deck Doctor now names the emulator and console, and checks the usual reasons it fails:

- **Emulator not installed**, e.g. after a SteamOS reset, or a Switch emulator EmuDeck no longer ships
- **Game file missing**: moved, renamed, or the SD card isn't in
- **Wii U disc images (.wux/.wud) with no key** in Cemu's keys.txt
- **Missing PS1 / PS2 BIOS**, recognised by file size, so a PS1 BIOS isn't mistaken for a PS2 one
- **Missing Switch prod.keys**

If none of those turn anything up, it still tells you which emulator to open to see the error. Each problem has a step-by-step guide in the plugin.

## Install / update
1. Download `deck-doctor.zip` below.
2. Decky → ⚙ → Developer → **Install plugin from ZIP**.

BIOS files, keys and games have to come from your own consoles. Deck Doctor only checks whether they're there.

kromossomom-debug/decky-switch2-dashboar.body:
This release adds a Nintendo Switch Online icon maker: build your user icon the way the console does, from a character, a frame and a background.

## What's new in 1.4.0

- **Nintendo Switch Online icons.** Open **My Page → User Settings → Nintendo Switch Online Icons** (or the new button in **Change Icon**):
  - Pick a **character**, a **frame** and a **background** from **66 game collections** and **over 7,500 parts**: Mario Kart World, Super Mario Bros. Wonder, Zelda, Splatoon, Kirby, Pokémon, Animal Crossing, Metroid, Miis and more. Frames and backgrounds can also be set to **None**.
  - A live preview shows the stacked icon as you go. **Surprise Me** (or **X**) picks a random one, and **Check for new icons** refreshes the list when the collection grows.
  - Your icon appears in the status bar, on My Page and in the Quick Settings menu.
- **Nothing bundled, works offline once saved.** The parts come from the community collection [henry-debruin/nso-icons](https://github.com/henry-debruin/nso-icons), the same one [nso-icon-tool](https://github.com/dslatt/nso-icon-tool) uses on the Switch. The plugin caches the part list, loads pictures from GitHub as you browse and saves your icon on the Deck as one PNG. Building an icon needs an internet connection; showing it doesn't.
- My Page now shows a new icon as soon as you save it, and the icon editors take over the page so the controller's focus goes straight into them.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/kromossomom-debug/decky-switch2-dashboard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for earlier versions.

## Install

1. Download **`switch2-dashboard.zip`** below.
2. In Game Mode: **Quick Access (`…`) → Decky → ⚙ Settings → General**, turn on **Developer mode**.
3. **Developer → Install plugin from ZIP**, pick `switch2-dashboard.zip`.

Updating? Install the new ZIP the same way; your settings are kept. The plugin panel should then show v1.4.0 at the bottom. If it still shows an older version, restart Steam.

zacharyqin/decky-sideloader.name: v0.4.0
zacharyqin/decky-sideloader.body:
## [0.4.0] - 2026-10-27

### English

- Show package warnings in a native confirmation dialog as soon as preparation completes. Continuing opens Decky's installation confirmation; cancellation keeps the prepared task available for an explicit retry. Preserve uninstall-and-reinstall confirmation and do not replay a pending dialog after reload.
- Bundle a maintained, independently versioned `plugin.json.name` to GitHub repository map for offline first-use recognition. Preserve explicit bindings, completed-install links, takeover repositories, stopped tracking and identity/ownership guards; fall back to package metadata when an entry is absent.
- Add a six-language Repository map section in Settings with revision/count/date and a separate update action using the selected network mode. Validate and atomically replace complete snapshots, retain the last good version on failure, prevent downgrades and changes during installation/release checks, and drain updates on reload. Validate maintained data and revision changes in CI and include the source-commit snapshot in runtime ZIPs.

### 中文

- 安装包准备完成后，以原生确认弹窗展示安装警告；继续后进入 Decky 安装确认，取消则保留已准备任务供用户主动重试。保留卸载并安装的独立确认，重载后不自动重弹。
- 随包附带独立版本的 `plugin.json.name` → GitHub 仓库映射表，首次使用离线识别；保留手动关联、成功安装确认的关联、接管仓库、停止追踪选择及身份／归属保护，未收录条目继续使用包元数据等现有来源。
- 设置新增六语“仓库映射表”区段，展示修订号、条目数、日期并单独更新，复用所选网络模式；完整校验后原子替换整表，失败保留旧版、防止降级，安装／版本检查期间不切换，重载时排空更新任务。CI 校验数据与修订号变更，运行 ZIP 附带源提交中的映射快照。
