zacharyqin/decky-sideloader.body:
## [0.3.0] - 2026-10-23

### English

- Rename the project and Decky plugin to `decky-sideloader`, including the Loader/API identity, scoped frontend styles and storage keys, diagnostic paths, package names, workflow artifacts and all six READMEs. Keep the existing version and plugin behavior.
- Apply the full readability review to all six READMEs: separate updating an installed plugin from installing a new one; keep feature summaries short and centralize version/maintenance instructions; group installation checks, cancellation, backup scope/location and cleanup; show capacity limits in a separate table; move connection and diagnostic guides into Usage and settings, with diagnostics grouped by download, sharing, included information and technical contents; give source builds a standalone developer section. Link package acquisition to the actual build instructions and `dist/` output instead of inventing a public download address. Keep internal storage-budget arithmetic out of the user guide.
- Move the project's original installation and update background out of the header into a dedicated Why decky-sideloader section after What you can do and before Install. Add a contents link in all six READMEs and keep the header focused on the product introduction; preserve the background about cross-mode ZIP installation, discovering updates through videos or group chats, and inconvenient version switching.
- Place the gallery's home-screen image after the contents and before What you can do. Keep all five feature titles and descriptions visible, with only screenshots in default-collapsed details/summary blocks, using tables for multi-image flows. Add compressed WebP screenshots for all six languages, captured from the real localized UI where needed; lazy-load images at 240px for single views and 180px per table image, and include the shared assets in runtime ZIPs for offline reading.
- Collect device information only for diagnostic exports: obtain the running Steam client version from the native API with a bounded wait, and read OS/build/kernel/architecture plus non-unique DMI vendor/model fields in the ZIP worker. Identify Steam Deck LCD/OLED from Valve Jupiter/Galileo hardware, not SteamOS alone; leave unavailable identities unknown, exclude unique identifiers, and never copy device metadata into routine logs or collect it on status refresh.
- Expand bounded diagnostic bundles with classified error codes and controlled source locations, session/request/parent/task correlation, independent dependency events, management/freeze snapshots, ownership transitions, operational settings and backup-cleanup counts. Treat healthy cached catalogs separately from Loader failures. Read existing persisted tasks without recovery or network activity; omit original messages, URLs, paths, credentials and user files, using pseudonymous target identifiers.
- Report independently calculated frontend/backend build fingerprints and the actual loaded frontend version; verify installed bundle metadata and refresh it on export so frontend-only replacements remain visible. Record plugin-scoped page/action/JS/render errors without swallowing the host's error, drain queued events before export with a bounded wait, and retain existing log/package size and sharing limits.
- Split the Python entry by feature under `backend/`: retain lifecycle handling in `backend/main.py` and move settings, plugin management, releases, installation and diagnostics into `backend/sideload/`. Package the Loader entry as `main.py` and modules as `py_modules/sideload/`; migrate consumers without legacy import shims.
- Add `pnpm package-plugin` and a GitHub build workflow for pull requests, `main` pushes and version tags. Validate, build and upload the runtime ZIP; matching version tags publish it with the complete English/Chinese changelog section, rejecting tag/package version mismatches.
- Automatically remove backup archives older than seven days at startup, hourly and before new installation preparation. Add a confirmed Delete data backups action in Settings, including recent backups while protecting active/unknown tasks and running workers. Preserve original data, packages and task evidence, show deletion status in backup details, and report partial cleanup failures across all six languages.
- Rewrite the user-facing README in the Power Timeline layout, keeping English at the repository root and complete Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese and Korean translations under `docs/readme/`. Include six-language navigation, installation and first-use instructions, backup boundaries, language settings and executable source-packaging commands; do not restore the removed design documents.
- Remove the standalone design prototype (`demo/`), unused empty `defaults/` directory and supplemental `docs/`. Remove obsolete source documentation indexes and README links; production behavior and translations are unchanged.
- Bring the approved demo's page hierarchy into the plugin: focus the home page on plugins and updates, with Install and Settings scrolling above the list. Split details into Overview, Other versions and Maintenance; move store plugins and source re-identification into Settings. Preserve installation, takeover, backup, cancellation and diagnostics.
- Unify new-install repository URLs and keyword search in one native input. Place the search button on its right with 16px outer insets and an 8px gap; Enter submits through the same path, without triggering on IME confirmation or repeated keys. Replace repository dropdown results with home-style rows that inspect the selected repository immediately. Keep drafts, results and return focus across navigation, stale-response guards, explicit monorepo selection and installation confirmation.
- Dismiss the native keyboard after Enter submits. Return from installation previews and search-origin installed details to the retained search results with either Back or B. Open the task page as soon as preparation starts, then show real download bytes, percentages and stages; preserve the preview/search return path and native installation confirmation.
- Add a third-party code/source warning above Continue installation in new-install previews. When the selected project's manifest declares root access, also show “This plugin has full access to your Steam Deck.” Keep it out of installed-plugin details, resolve monorepo candidates independently and cover all six UI languages. Reuse repository discovery without extra requests; retain actual ZIP checks without adding a checkbox or confirmation dialog.
- Prepare declared remote binaries before native installation using the task's existing network mode and deadline, verify SHA-256, and embed them in a rechecked local ZIP while retaining the source archive. Show separate main-package/dependency progress, native stages and explicit failures. Require correlated Loader start/finish evidence plus all installed-file checks before success; remove timeout-based false success and revoke old success records lacking completion evidence.
- Replace the task's phase list with compact connected dots: show all eight installation steps, activate the current and preceding dots, and show only the current step's label below. Add an uninstall step for explicit uninstall-and-install. Derive the position from actual task evidence; failures, cancellation, manual closure and unknown results never light later steps. Preserve download progress, errors, backup details and actions.
- Refresh the installed list and selected details after successful installation, including QAM remounts, so Back/B uses the current version and update state. Discard list reads started before completion instead of letting them satisfy the refresh.
- Observe completion of native standalone uninstall, refresh the local plugin list, and leave removed-plugin pages for Home instead of retaining stale identity errors across QAM remounts. Preserve native confirmation, cancelled/failed operations, newer selections and the intermediate removal phase of reinstall.
- Determine native store management from the current Loader registry and update capability in its configured Default, Testing or Custom channel. Historical store-name matches no longer force takeover of an unregistered plugin. Share the same native observation between backend authorization and UI, retain explicit ownership/freeze guards, cache update capability per channel and refresh it only explicitly; unknown capability does not grant installation permission.
- Place Dismiss notice and Don't remind again side by side for terminal tasks. Dismiss only the exact task; Don't remind again first saves the task-notice preference and then dismisses that task. Apply the saved preference on every page, hide banners until it is loaded, and prevent late reads from overriding a newer choice. Keep task evidence and the recent-task entry, preserve save-failure visibility, and allow re-enabling notices in Settings.
- Add a native-styled offline license reader under Settings, with grouped components, collapsed transitive dependencies, versions, attribution, source links and full license documents. Generate notices from modules actually shipped in the bundle, including Font Awesome and embedded-source notices; distinguish host-provided Decky UI. Preserve document selection and expansion across QAM remounts and restore focus on hierarchical Back/B navigation.
- Add Simplified Chinese, English, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese and Korean. The native language dropdown shows SVG flags and language names in their own languages. Follow the Steam/browser language automatically or persist a manual choice independently; switching languages preserves drafts, version selections, tasks and confirmation checkboxes.
- Use the actual 300px QAM container with 16px content insets and the native panel background; remove the custom gray background and fixed bottom bar. Home rows have 12px vertical and 16px horizontal padding; navigation has a 44px minimum height and 8px vertical padding, expanding for long text. Scope Field overrides to prevent native 10px vertical padding from taking precedence.
- Correct differences between the first plugin UI and the demo: headings, group counts, icon columns, version summaries and explicit version lists, maintenance navigation, four network choices and expandable backup details. Return to Overview after selecting a version. Remove duplicate spacing caused by differences between Decky's section styles and similarly named Steam classes, leaving 268px of content width; preserve native controls, confirmations, persistence and user themes.
- Keep the home update-check button compact and rectangular with a clear focus contrast, scoped to this plugin so global theme rounding and focus rings do not override it. Align Install and Settings with the content, with an 8px gap between them and 24px before the list, without stacking margins.
- Unify horizontal insets across all pages: remove home/settings-only layout branches and section-level horizontal padding. Lists, navigation, forms, lightweight actions and expandable rows use their own 16px padding, full 300px backgrounds and zero horizontal margins instead of negative form margins. Align headings, descriptions, release bodies and non-full-row buttons separately; include native input labels, fields and descriptions so focus does not shift their position.
- Fix the missed parent section around task notices: the View task and Dismiss task notice rows on Home and Settings span 300px with zero horizontal margins and 16px padding. Keep content insets for the home heading, update check and button pair without narrowing task backgrounds through the whole overview section. Preserve full-row focus and internal insets for Back, repository mode, release notes, version skipping and expandable rows. Remove the blue outline and duplicate native focus ring from network radio choices; cover native form controls such as the download timeout.
- Fix the list still showing Not checked for updates after reading versions in plugin details. Installed-plugin details reuse the backend check and save the individual result, including after returning to the list or a late response. Failures do not masquerade as Up to date; preserve other plugin results, scheduled history and the full-check cycle.
- Stop repeated network requests when reopening details, remounting QAM or switching between Overview, Versions and Maintenance. Share complete successful Release snapshots with full update checks, merge in-flight reads for the same identity and replace successful results only on explicit refresh. On failure, retain the previous content and timestamp alongside the error; do not invent a fallback without a successful record. Persist bounded snapshots separately, restore them after reload and invalidate them on identity changes, without changing version comparison, installation authorization or network preferences.
- Show download totals for the selected release in plugin details and new-install previews, updating when the version changes. Sum GitHub's uploaded-asset download counts; show zero for an empty asset list and Unknown for missing statistics or older snapshots. Reuse the existing cached release reads and refresh behavior, without extra requests on navigation. Group package names and download totals as aligned release metadata with matching 12px text and icons, without explanatory subtext; all six UI languages are covered.
- Move the detail update action above the release summary, with an icon-only refresh button on its right. Both use the same native primary-button appearance and height. Place Skip this version / Undo skip last, using the same full-width navigation row as Choose another version and Maintain this plugin. Preserve loading, disabled states and installation guards.
- Render release notes as GitHub-flavored Markdown in both the preview and a separate full-notes page, including headings, lists, code, tables and images. Full release notes uses the same native navigation row as Choose another version and Maintain this plugin, rather than expanding inline. Preserve the selected release and install draft across navigation and QAM remounts, return focus to the entry, and provide native paragraph reading stops. Sanitize embedded HTML and URLs; reuse the cached body without another Release request.
- Keep a compact Back row on every inner page, naming its actual destination. Use 8px vertical padding and automatic height rather than a fixed-height bar; remove the extra top gap. Preserve native B-button navigation and return focus, and keep shared page headings out of the focus order without changing their appearance or body reading stops. Keep the native ScrollPanel responsible for left-stick scrolling. When no primary version action is shown, place Refresh at the far right of the last-updated row; keep it beside the primary action otherwise. Move the skipped-version notice beneath the plugin heading and size it to its content.
- Remove the gap between Full release notes and Choose another version. Distinguish Up to date from Latest release skipped in the home list using matching cached releases and skip rules; without a matching snapshot, only claim Releases skipped. Keep errors and other available updates visible, without extra network requests.
- Treat Skip / Undo skip as local filtering, not a Release cache identity change. Recompute the affected update result from complete cached releases and saved package-version evidence without Release, ZIP or Git requests. Preserve the selected release/asset, successful timestamps, scheduled history and existing refresh errors; an in-flight check uses the latest skip rules before publishing.
- Correct the five-second query timeout boundary: JSON/raw, ZIP Range and official store queries wait at most five seconds for complete response headers, then time out only after five consecutive seconds without body progress. Continuous reception may exceed five seconds; HTTP 200 responses are no longer cut off because total elapsed time reaches five seconds. Timeouts still select fallback routes according to the existing network mode, with body-size, length and parsing checks unchanged. Full downloads retain 60-second connection/header and no-body-data waits plus the existing 3–30-minute total package deadline; cache identity rules and skipped versions remain unchanged.
- Add a Language / 语言 entry with a language icon at the bottom of both Home and Settings, sharing the same native dropdown and preference. It scrolls with the content rather than adding a fixed footer; changing either entry updates the other. Keep language self-names and flags so users can recover from an unfamiliar language. Render flags as separate SVG images to isolate them from the native menu's forced white fill on focused items, without changing native highlighting or language persistence.
- Align icon columns and content insets across plugin details, loading notices, repository search results and task pages; remove the native icon container's 10px right padding. Make Choose another version and Maintain this plugin two consecutive compact detail rows. Reduce Settings navigation icons to 16px; home plugin rows and settings navigation span 300px with zero horizontal margins and 16px horizontal padding aligned to group headings, without shifting on focus or pushing icons against the edge.
- Show the full service address and trust risks before switching to a third-party connection mode, and require explicit consent before saving. Cancelling retains the previous mode; active tasks do not change routes.
- Preserve original Release bodies, repositories/paths, backend errors and historical evidence rather than inventing translations. Not pushed or published.

### 中文

- 项目与Decky插件统一改名为`decky-sideloader`，同步Loader／API标识、前端作用域样式与存储键、诊断路径、安装包名称、workflow产物及六语README；保留当前版本和既有功能行为。
- 六语README全量落实易读性审查：首次使用拆为更新已有插件与安装新插件；功能概览只讲能力，版本与维护细则集中到使用说明；安装确认、取消、备份范围与位置、清理规则分别分组，容量限制独立成表；连接与诊断归入“使用与设置”，诊断按下载、分享、采集信息及技术内容分组；源码构建独立到开发者信息。获取安装包链接到实际构建步骤及`dist/`产物，不虚构公开下载地址；内部存储预算计算不放入用户说明。
- 六语README将两段原始背景移至“可以做什么”之后、“安装”之前新增的“为什么做decky-sideloader”一节，并加入目录；头部只保留产品介绍。保留跨模式下载与寻找ZIP的安装长链路、靠视频或群消息发现更新、新版不好用时切换版本不便的原始叙事。
- 首页头图移至目录之后、“可以做什么”之前；五个功能场景的标题和正文常显，仅配图放入默认折叠的details/summary，多图流程用table并排。六语配图统一压缩为WebP，缺失语言从实机对应界面补拍；图片懒加载，单图240px、表格内每张180px，并随运行ZIP打包以支持离线阅读。
- 设备信息仅在诊断导出时采集：通过原生API有界读取运行中的Steam客户端版本，在实际生成ZIP的工作线程中读取系统／构建号／内核／架构及非唯一DMI厂商／型号。按Valve Jupiter／Galileo识别Steam Deck LCD／OLED，不用SteamOS推断硬件；无法识别时保留未知，排除唯一标识，不写入日常日志，状态刷新不采集。
- 扩展有界诊断包：补齐分类错误码、受控源码位置、会话／请求／父请求／任务关联、独立依赖事件、管理归属／冻结快照、接管步骤、必要运行开关与备份清理统计。区分健康的本地目录缓存与 Loader 故障；只读已有落盘任务，不恢复任务或发起联网。目标使用匿名标识，不包含原始错误文本、URL、路径、凭据或用户文件。
- 独立计算前后端构建指纹，记录实际加载的前端版本；校验磁盘 bundle 元数据并在导出时重新读取，识别只替换前端的情况。补齐仅限本插件的页面／操作／JS／渲染异常记录，不吞掉宿主原异常；导出前有界等待队列刷新，保留既有日志／包大小及分享限制。
- 将Python后端按功能拆入`backend/`：`backend/main.py`只保留生命周期，设置、插件管理、发布版本、安装与诊断移至`backend/sideload/`。打包时生成Loader要求的根`main.py`与`py_modules/sideload/`，调用方及测试同步迁移，不保留旧导入兼容层。
- 新增`pnpm package-plugin`及GitHub构建workflow，覆盖Pull Request、`main`推送和版本标签；检查、构建并上传运行ZIP。版本标签与包版本一致时发布ZIP，Release正文使用完整英中版本章节，版本不匹配则拒绝打包。
- 超过七天的备份在启动、每小时及准备新安装前自动删除；设置新增须确认的“清理数据备份”，可同时清理近期备份，保护活动／未知任务与仍运行的工作线程。保留原数据、安装包和任务证据，备份详情显示删除状态，部分清理失败如实报告，六语同步。
- 按Power Timeline结构重写面向用户的README：根目录只保留英语，简中、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、日语、韩语全文放在`docs/readme/`；提供六语导航、安装与首次使用、备份边界、语言设置及可执行的源码打包命令，不恢复已删除的设计文档。
- 删除独立设计原型`demo/`、未使用的空目录`defaults/`及附属文档目录`docs/`；清理源码失效文档索引与README链接，正式运行逻辑与多语言词条保持不变。
- 将已确认 Demo 的页面层级接入正式插件：首页聚焦插件与更新，安装和设置在列表上方随正文滚动；详情拆分概览、其他版本和维护，商店插件与重新识别移入设置。原安装、接管、备份、取消和诊断能力保留。
- 新装仓库地址与关键词搜索合并为一个原生输入框，右侧放搜索按钮，左右各16px留白、间隔8px；回车走相同提交入口，不把输入法确认或重复按键当成新提交。仓库结果由下拉改为首页风格列表，点选即探查；保留输入草稿、结果与返回焦点、过时响应隔离、monorepo显式选择和安装确认。
- 回车提交后收起原生键盘。安装预览及搜索进入的已安装详情通过顶部返回或B键回到原搜索结果，保留输入与行焦点。安装准备开始即进入任务页，随后展示真实下载字节、百分比与阶段；保留任务返回预览／搜索的路径及原生安装确认。
- 新装预览在“继续安装”上方提示第三方代码与来源风险；所选项目声明root权限时另显示“此插件可以完全访问你的 Steam Deck。”。已安装详情不显示，monorepo按所选项目独立判断，覆盖六种界面语言。复用仓库探查、不增加请求；保留实际ZIP校验，不新增勾选或确认弹窗。
- 在原生安装前按任务既有连接模式与时限下载声明的额外依赖，校验SHA-256后合入重新核验的本地ZIP，并保留原始包。任务页分开展示主包／依赖进度、Loader阶段和明确失败原因。成功必须同时取得关联的Loader开始／完成证据及全部安装文件核验；移除超时后仅凭文件判成功的路径，撤销旧的无完成证据成功记录。
- 任务阶段列表改为紧凑圆点连线：保留全部8个安装步骤，点亮当前及之前节点，下方只显示当前步骤文字；“卸载并安装”另加卸载节点。位置由真实任务证据决定，失败、取消、手动结束及未知结果不点亮后续步骤；保留下载进度、错误、备份详情和操作。
- 安装成功后刷新已安装清单及当前详情，QAM重挂同样生效；B/返回显示当前版本与更新状态。丢弃安装完成前启动的迟到清单，不能以旧请求代替完成后的刷新。
- 监听独立卸载的原生调用完成，刷新本地插件清单并从已移除目标的页面返回首页，避免QAM重挂后仍显示过时身份错误。保留原生确认、取消／失败时的页面、新选择及重装中间卸载阶段。
- 商店管理改以Loader当前登记与其Default／Testing／Custom频道的原生更新能力共同判定；历史商店同名记录不再迫使未登记插件先接管。前后端授权与展示共用同一原生快照，保留显式接管、冻结及身份守卫；按频道保存更新能力，只有显式刷新才联网，未知不授予安装权限。
- 终态任务的“关闭任务提醒”与“不再提醒”改为两个并排按钮。关闭只隐藏精确当前任务；不再提醒先保存关闭任务提示，再隐藏当前任务。所有页面统一遵守已保存的开关值，读取完成前不显示横栏，迟到读取不能覆盖新选择。保留任务证据及最近任务入口，保存失败不假成功，可从设置重新开启提示。
- 设置新增本插件风格的离线开源许可页：组件分组、间接依赖折叠、版本／署名／来源及许可证全文。依据真正进入bundle的模块生成材料，包含Font Awesome和内嵌代码声明，区分宿主提供的Decky UI；QAM重挂保留文档与展开状态，顶部返回及B逐级返回并恢复焦点。
- 接入简中、英语、葡语、西语、日语、韩语，原生语言下拉显示 SVG 国旗与语言自称。自动读取 Steam/浏览器语言，手动选择独立持久保存；切换不清空草稿、版本选择、任务或确认框勾选。
- 使用真实300px QAM容器及16px内容留白，沿用原生面板背景，移除插件自绘灰底与固定底栏。首页条目上下12px、左右16px；导航最小44px、上下8px，长文案自然增高；局部提高Field规则优先级，避免原生上下10px覆盖。
- 纠正首轮正式界面与 Demo 的还原偏差：标题/分组计数/图标列、版本摘要与显式版本列表、维护导航行、网络四选项和备份详情展开；选择版本后返回概览。修正 Decky 内部区段样式与 Steam 同名类不同造成的重复留白，正文可用宽度268px；保留原生控件、确认、持久化和用户主题。
- 修正首页检查更新按钮被全局主题圆角／聚焦环覆盖的问题，仅在本插件内保留紧凑矩形与清晰聚焦对比。安装／设置按钮左右与正文对齐、相隔8px，与下方列表留24px，不叠加多层边距。
- 全部页面统一左右留白：移除仅首页／设置生效的布局分支，区段横向padding归零，列表、导航、表单、轻量操作和展开项均由自身16px padding承担内容留白，背景铺满300px、左右margin为0，不再依赖表单负边距。标题、说明、发布正文和非整行按钮单独对齐；原生输入标题、输入框及说明一并覆盖，聚焦前后位置不变。
- 修正任务提示父区段漏改的问题：首页及设置中的“查看任务／关闭任务提示”两行背景铺满300px，左右margin为0、padding为16px；首页标题、检查和双按钮区保留内容留白，不再用整个概览区段的padding缩窄任务背景。返回、仓库模式、发布说明、跳过版本和展开项保留整行焦点及内部留白。网络单选移除蓝框及原生重复焦点环；表单留白覆盖网络下载时限等原生控件。
- 修复详情读取版本后列表仍显示“尚未检查更新”：已安装插件详情复用后端检查并保存单项结果，返回列表或请求迟到完成都会同步；失败不冒充已是最新，其他插件结果、定时历史及整轮检查周期保留。
- 修复详情重进、QAM重挂及概览／版本／维护切换重复联网：与整轮检查共享完整成功Release快照，同身份在途读取合并，显式刷新才替换成功结果；失败保留上次内容与时间并显示错误，无成功记录时不虚构回退。快照独立有界落盘、重载恢复，身份变化失效；不改变版本比较、安装授权或网络偏好。
- 插件详情与新装预览显示所选版本的下载量，切换版本同步变化；合计 GitHub 当前 Release 上传附件的下载次数，空附件列表为0，统计缺失或旧快照显示未知。复用现有 Release 缓存与刷新，不因切页增加请求。包名与下载量合并为对齐的版本元属性，文字与图标均为12px，不显示解释小字，覆盖六种界面语言。
- 详情更新按钮移至版本摘要上方，右侧保留图标刷新按钮；两者使用相同原生主按钮外观与高度。“跳过此版本／取消跳过”放到最后，复用“选择其他版本／维护此插件”的整行导航尺寸和布局，保留加载、禁用状态及安装守卫。
- 版本说明预览与独立全文页均渲染GitHub风格Markdown，支持标题、列表、代码、表格与图片。“查看完整发布说明”复用“选择其他版本／维护此插件”的原生导航行，不再原地展开；跨页面与QAM重挂保留所选版本和新装草稿，返回恢复入口焦点，全文提供原生段落阅读焦点。清理嵌入HTML与URL，复用缓存正文，不额外请求Release。
- 所有内页保留紧凑返回栏，写明实际目标页面；上下padding为8px、自然撑高，不锁固定高度，移除额外顶部空白。保留原生B键层级返回与焦点恢复，共享页标题不再参与焦点导航，标题样式及正文阅读焦点不变。原生ScrollPanel继续承载左摇杆滚动。没有主要版本操作时，刷新收到“版本信息更新于”行最右侧；有操作时仍与主按钮同排。已跳过提示位于插件标题下方，按内容自然撑高。
- 去掉“查看完整发布说明”和“选择其他版本”之间的间隔。首页依据匹配的Release快照与跳过规则区分“已是最新”和“已跳过最新版本”；无匹配快照时只显示“已跳过版本”。不遮盖检查失败或仍可安装的其他更新，不增加联网请求。
- 跳过／取消跳过改为本地筛选，不再使Release缓存身份变化；从完整缓存和已保存的包版本证据重算该插件的更新状态，不抓取Release、ZIP或Git。保留所选版本／安装包、成功时间、定时历史及已有刷新错误；在途检查发布前采用最新跳过规则。
- 修正查询5秒超时边界：JSON/raw、ZIP Range及官方商店查询等待完整响应头最多5秒，随后按连续5秒无正文进展超时；持续接收可超过5秒，不再在HTTP200后因整段耗时达到5秒而截断。超时仍按原网络模式切备用通道，正文大小、长度和解析校验不变。完整下载保持60秒连接／响应头及正文无数据等待、原3–30分钟整包总时限；缓存身份规则和跳过设置不变。
- 首页与设置页内容最底部均提供“Language / 语言”入口及语言图标，复用同一原生下拉与语言偏好，随正文滚动、不加固定底栏；在任一入口切换后另一处同步。选项继续使用各语言自称与国旗，误选陌生语言也可直接改回。国旗作为独立SVG图片显示，隔离原生菜单聚焦项强制白色fill，不改变原生高亮和语言保存行为。
- 统一插件详情、加载提示、仓库搜索结果与任务页的图标列和正文留白，清除原生图标容器的10px右内边距；详情“选择其他版本 / 维护此插件”改为连续紧凑两行。设置导航图标缩至16px；首页插件行和设置导航行的背景铺满300px，左右margin为0、内容用左右16px padding与分组标题对齐，聚焦不改变位置或让图标贴边。
- 切换到第三方连接模式前，完整展示服务地址与信任风险，须主动同意才能保存；取消保留原模式，进行中的任务不切换通道。
- 原始 Release 正文、仓库/路径、后端错误及历史证据保持原样，不改写为推测翻译。本轮未推送或发布。

k1tsune12/deck-animations.name: 🎬 Deck Animations v0.16.5
k1tsune12/deck-animations.body:
## 🎬 Deck Animations v0.16.5

The biggest update yet: Deck Animations now runs on a **TV / Steam Machine** as well as on the Steam Deck, gets a screensaver section made for **OLED screens**, and a rebuilt library. One release for both: the plugin detects which device it is on.

### 📺 TV and Steam Machine
- 🔎 **Device detection** (battery, internal panel, backlight, DMI): on a TV the battery settings are hidden and only the plugged-in timeouts count. You can also pick Handheld or TV yourself in Settings.
- 🖼️ **Video size**: a new Settings section holds both defaults, for screensavers and for boot/suspend. Each video can still have its own size, and one button sends them all back to the default.
- 🎞️ **Boot and suspend fill a 16:9 TV**: Steam crops 16:10 videos, so the chosen ones can be re-encoded once to 1920x1080 (fit with bars, fill or stretch), per video or for all.
- 🌙 Turning the display off works on screens without a backlight.

### ⚫ Screensavers for OLED
- 🕰️ **Clocks**: digital, analog, rings and aurora, with colours, font, size, brightness, seconds, date and 12/24 h. Movement: slide now and then, bounce off the edges, float, or stay put at one of nine spots or a custom position, at slow, normal or fast speed.
- ✨ **OLED art**: fireflies, northern lights, fireworks, lava lamp and silk, on pure black, with two colours of your choice and an optional clock on top in its own colour.
- 🎥 Every card shows the **real animation** with your settings, and anything can be previewed full screen before you install it: repo videos stream from steamdeckrepo, GIFs show at full size.

### 📚 A cleaner library
- 🧹 Rows with a thumbnail, the title, small state icons and two buttons: **Preview** and a menu with everything else. List or grid, filters (in use, screensavers, boot, suspend, GIFs, classics, OLED, disabled), sort, and tags in a dropdown.
- 📌 **In use now**: switch the active screensaver and the boot, suspend and throbber videos in place.
- ☑️ **Select** videos, GIFs, classics, clocks and OLED art at once. Only the actions that apply are shown, each with how many items it affects, and anything on 3 or more items asks first.
- ⏸️ **Disable** anything without deleting it: it stays in the library but leaves Steam's list, the rotation and the boot/suspend choices.
- 💾 Option dialogs end with **Cancel** and **Save** (Cancel puts back what you changed), the others with **Close**.

### 🧭 Easier to find
- Tabs by purpose: **Boot & suspend**, **Screensavers** (clocks, OLED art, classics, GIFs), Library, Rotation and Settings.
- The rotation lists use the same rows as the library and have a grid view too.

### 🐛 Fixes
- 🎞️ **GIFs no longer play black**: Steam cannot decode GIPHY's H.264 MP4, so GIFs are converted to WebM (new ones on install, existing ones automatically).
- ⚡ Previews open at once and never bring up the rotation or another screensaver, even when started quickly one after another.
- 🎮 L1/R1 tab switching no longer tears the page, the controller moves card to card in grids, and focus stays visible on coloured buttons.
- 🫧 Bubbles, polygons and curves keep their proportions in small views, and card buttons never cut their labels on the Deck.

### 📦 Install / update
Decky → Developer → **Install Plugin from ZIP** → pick `Deck-Animations.zip`. Your library, settings and videos are kept.

k1tsune12/deck-animations.name: 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.13
k1tsune12/deck-animations.body:
## 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.13

### ⚡ Lighter on your battery
- 🕹️ **Classics draw at 30 fps**: about half the CPU while they're on screen (~4–5% of one core instead of ~8–11%), with the same speed and look.
- 💤 **Less background work while you play or idle**: the plugin checks Steam's screensaver state every 5 s instead of every second (Steam's own notifications report changes), and checks for open menus half as often. The background cost was already tiny and is now negligible.
- 🖥️ Videos and GIFs are still decoded by the hardware, and nothing runs once the display is off.

### 📦 Install / update
Decky → Developer → **Install Plugin from ZIP** → pick `Deck-Animations.zip`. Your library, settings and videos are kept.

k1tsune12/deck-animations.name: 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.12
k1tsune12/deck-animations.body:
## 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.12

### 🔀 Rotation fix
- The screensaver rotation in **random** order never started: the screen stayed black and then turned off. Classics, videos and GIFs now play again.
- Updates to the player now always load. Steam was keeping an old copy of the screensaver page.

### ⏻ Power button
- After the screensaver finishes (black screen or display off), the power button now **wakes the screen** instead of suspending. Press it again to suspend as usual. Idle suspend from Steam's own timer still works.

### 📦 Install / update
Decky → Developer → **Install Plugin from ZIP** → pick `Deck-Animations.zip`. Your library, settings and videos are kept.

k1tsune12/deck-animations.name: 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.5
k1tsune12/deck-animations.body:
## 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.5

### 🌑 Real display off
- **Turn the display off** now switches the panel itself off through Steam's Gamescope service, so nothing shows, not even Steam notifications. Before, it only darkened the OLED panel.

k1tsune12/deck-animations.name: 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.0
k1tsune12/deck-animations.body:
## 🎬 Deck Animations v0.13.0

Everything your Steam Deck shows when you're not playing, in one plugin.

### ✨ Highlights
- 🚀 **Boot & suspend videos** from steamdeckrepo.com (~8,700), with search and preview
- 🖼️ **Native Steam screensavers** from your videos, GIFs 🐸 and six live-generated **classics** 🕹️ (Digital Rain in any colour 🎨)
- 📚 **Library** with filters, #tags, renaming and full-screen preview
- 🔄 **Rotation**: random or your own order, plays per video, seconds per classic, randomize on boot or every X minutes (never during a game)
- 🔁 **Boomerang**, fill / fit / original size, and **turn the display off** when it finishes 🌑
- ⏱️ Steam's screensaver & sleep timeouts, 💾 storage overview, 🌐 English + Português (Brasil)
- 🧳 **Migrate from Animation Changer**: import, back up, restore or delete backups

### 📦 Install
1. ⚠️ Remove any other plugin that changes boot or suspend animations (import from Animation Changer first, if you use it).
2. Decky → ⚙️ Settings → General → enable **Developer Mode**.
3. Developer → **Install Plugin from ZIP** → pick `Deck-Animations.zip`.

burghr/decky-xodus-chat.name: v0.1.0
burghr/decky-xodus-chat.body:
First release of XBOX Chat, a Decky plugin for Xbox friends and text chat through Xodus Nexus.

Unofficial side project, provided as is. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or Xbox, or by the Xodus Nexus project.

## Features
- Friends list in the Quick Access menu, sorted by the newest message, with a preview of the last message.
- Chat with the newest message at the bottom. Enter or the arrow button sends.
- B goes back from a chat to the friends list. The gamepad focus goes to the text box when a chat opens.
- Count of new messages for each friend, and an optional background check every 2 minutes with a notification.
- The last friends and messages show at once after a restart.

## Requirements
- Decky Loader.
- Xodus Nexus 0.4.0 or later with backend 0.2.12 or later, signed in. Nexus does not need to run.

Tested on a Steam Deck (SteamOS 3.9). Not yet tested on ARM devices.

## Install
1. Download `decky-xodus-chat-0.1.0.zip`.
2. In Decky, open Settings > Developer.
3. Select "Install Plugin from ZIP" and select the ZIP.

If you installed a test build named "Xodus Chat", uninstall it first.

## Privacy
The plugin keeps friends and recent messages in a base64 file (mode 0600) so that they show at once after a restart. Base64 is not encryption. See the README for details.

williamg007/legion-go2-leds.name: Legion Go 2 LEDs 1.0.9

Decky plugin for the Lenovo Legion Go 2 joystick RGB and power-button LED on SteamOS.

After boot and wake the plugin waits for the controllers and force-writes the rings, so the lights come back without toggling modes.

xmfan/decky-pinyin.name: v0.7.6 · Smaller adjustable fonts
xmfan/decky-pinyin.body:
## Smaller adjustable fonts

- Display → Text size now spans **10–32 px**, with **1 px steps** and a numeric size readout.
- Chinese and pinyin scale together; **English stays smaller than Chinese**. For example, 12 px Chinese uses 9 px English; 10 px Chinese uses 8 px English.
- Font changes keep the current capture, loaded models and speech. Close the panel to preview the new size without recapturing.
- Fresh installs default to the smallest size. Updates retain your saved choice; lower it in Display → Text size.
- Move Display above Updates so the font control is easier to find.

From v0.7.4 or newer, open **Updates → Check for updates → Update to 0.7.6** and confirm in Decky. Older versions can install **Decky-Pinyin-0.7.6-offline.zip** manually.

TypeScript/build, browser interaction/layout checks, and 17 targeted Python tests pass. Checks cover the live slider, Chinese/pinyin/English sizing, screen bounds, preserved capture/speech and saved font settings. Physical Deck readability and native update replacement/reload still need a device check.

xmfan/decky-pinyin.name: v0.7.5 · Tap to refresh and lighter backgrounds
xmfan/decky-pinyin.body:
## Tap L4 to refresh

- With labels visible, tap and release L4 before 0.2 seconds to capture again using the current Simplified/Traditional selection.
- Hold either L4 or L5 for 0.2 seconds to dismiss. Holding and releasing cannot also trigger a refresh.
- With no overlay, hold L4 for Simplified or L5 for Traditional as before.
- Ignore short L5 presses and taps while recognition is busy. Pressing both script keys cancels the gesture until both are released.
- Make label backgrounds more transparent: 80% opacity instead of 94%. Reduce full-screen dimming from 12% to 8%; text remains fully opaque.

**From v0.7.4:** open Decky Pinyin → Updates → Check for updates → Update to 0.7.5, then confirm in Decky's dialog.

**From older versions:** install Decky-Pinyin-0.7.5-offline.zip manually once.

TypeScript/build and browser checks pass, including tap/hold distinction, retained Traditional and Simplified selections, ignored busy taps, long holds without repeated actions, chord cancellation and unloading during a press. Existing overlay, updater, speech and capture checks pass. Actual Deck gesture timing, readability and the native update install/reload still need a device check.

xmfan/decky-pinyin.name: v0.7.4 · Update from the Decky plugin
xmfan/decky-pinyin.body:
## Update directly from the plugin

- Add **Updates → Check for updates**, followed by **Update to …** when a newer release exists.
- Decky's native dialog handles confirmation, download, SHA-256 verification and plugin reload.
- Include numbered prereleases, show the available version/download size, and prevent accidental downgrades.
- Report offline, timeout, rate-limit, incomplete-release and unsupported-installer errors with retry available. No automatic update polling or credentials.
- Keep recognition, pinyin, translation and speech fully offline.

**Install Decky-Pinyin-0.7.4-offline.zip manually once to get the update buttons.** Future releases can then be installed from the plugin. Internet is needed only for checking/downloading updates.

The README now focuses on installation and use; development/build/release guidance moved to AGENTS.md. It explicitly describes the plugin as functional but still under development, with UX work remaining, and explains that the public repository makes in-plugin updates easier.

TypeScript/build and browser checks pass, including release ordering, prereleases, checksum validation, error recovery and the exact native installer handoff. An anonymous live release/checksum request also passed. Actual download, replacement and reload through Decky still need a physical Steam Deck check.

xmfan/decky-pinyin.name: v0.7.3 · Compact labels and ordered dialogue
xmfan/decky-pinyin.body:
## Compact overlay and correct dialogue order

- Keep dialogue rows in reading order. If the bottom rows run out of room, move the group upward; use additional pages only when it cannot fit.
- Smaller default text: 14 px Chinese, about 9 px pinyin, and 11 px English. The text-size slider now starts at 14 px.
- Reduce padding, line spacing, token spacing and gaps between cards. Short cards can be narrower without forcing long dialogue into narrow columns.
- Replace the sound emoji with a small monochrome speaker icon. Automatic Mandarin speech remains on by default.
- Preserve the working game-window overlay, dark label backgrounds and subtle screen dimming.

Install **Decky-Pinyin-0.7.3-offline.zip** through Decky's ZIP installer. It includes the local models and runtime; no model download is needed on the Deck. Existing saved text size can be lowered to 14 in the panel.

Verified locally with TypeScript/build, browser layout and interaction checks, and 13 configuration/plugin tests. Browser regressions cover bottom-row order, variable heights, paging, compact fonts, separate loader/game windows and existing hotkeys/speech. The user confirmed 0.7.2 renders on Deck; 0.7.3 compactness/readability still needs a device check.

xmfan/decky-pinyin.name: v0.7.2 — Render labels in the correct Steam window
xmfan/decky-pinyin.body:
## Fix: overlay rendered into the wrong Steam window
A two-window regression test reproduced the v0.7.1 failure: the component was rendered into a 1280×800 game UI window, but its overlay was attached to the module's 320×240 loader window. The game UI had no labels while recognition and speech continued.

The overlay now obtains its document from the element actually rendered by Decky (`ownerDocument`) and measures the full-screen overlay surface itself. It no longer uses the module-global document or viewport to select and size the overlay.

The same test now shows two labels in the game window and none in the loader. It also verifies correct capture coordinates, game-window resizing/letterboxing, no movement when the loader window resizes, and correct cleanup.

## Retained behavior
- L4 Simplified / L5 Traditional; 0.2-second capture/dismiss holds.
- Wide dark labels at source positions, no overlapping labels or pinyin.
- Previous/Next pages for dense captures.
- Light 12% screen dimming; no full-screen screenshot or opaque black background.
- Automatic offline Mandarin speech.

Install **Decky-Pinyin-0.7.2-offline.zip** through Decky's ZIP installer. Browser checks reproduce and fix the window mismatch; actual Steam Deck confirmation is still needed.

jayprates/deckdrop-decky.name: DeckDrop 1.2.0
jayprates/deckdrop-decky.body: Pause and resume transfers from the Deck or the PC (needs the DeckDrop PC app 1.2). Receiving uses about 64% less CPU per GB, which helps on handhelds at low power limits and on fast Wi-Fi. Older PC apps keep working.

jayprates/deckdrop-decky.name: DeckDrop 1.1.0
jayprates/deckdrop-decky.body: Faster transfers: files now arrive over 4 parallel connections in 2 MB blocks, disk writes overlap with receiving, and small files are saved in one step. Works with older DeckDrop PC apps too (they keep using one connection).

jayprates/deckdrop-decky.name: DeckDrop 1.0.1
jayprates/deckdrop-decky.body: Saves to the right home folder outside SteamOS (the user running Steam, even when Decky runs plugins as root), uses the desktop's Documents folder name (e.g. ~/Documentos), shows full paths, and logs where files were saved.

jayprates/deckdrop-decky.name: DeckDrop 1.0.0
jayprates/deckdrop-decky.body: First release. Install with the command in the README, or in Decky: Developer -> Install Plugin from ZIP File.

sunim87/decky-eclipse.name: Decky Eclipse v0.2.6
sunim87/decky-eclipse.body:
- 새로고침할 때 GitHub의 새롭게 검증된 이클립스 모드 설치 규칙을 함께 받아옵니다.
- 규칙이 없거나 배포 파일 정보와 일치하지 않으면 검증 대기로 표시합니다. 갱신 실패 시 마지막으로 확인한 규칙을 사용합니다.

sunim87/decky-eclipse.name: Decky Eclipse v0.2.5
sunim87/decky-eclipse.body:
- 스텔라 블레이드 1.4.1 물 표면 수정 ZIP을 반영했습니다.
- 사이버펑크 2077 2.5 비공식 포트와 더 위쳐 3 Steam DX12 5.0.16을 추가했습니다.
- 확인한 기타 모드 배포본만 자동 설치하며, 기존 백업으로 원상 복구할 수 있습니다.
- Steam Deck의 테스트 폴더에서 세 배포본의 다운로드·설치·복구를 확인했습니다. 사이버펑크 2077 2.5는 실제 게임 폴더에서도 설치·복구를 완료했으며, 대상 7개 경로의 파일 내용과 존재 여부가 테스트 전과 일치했습니다.

sunim87/decky-eclipse.name: Decky Eclipse v0.2.4
sunim87/decky-eclipse.body:
- 빌드가 다른 게임도 모드 설치 버튼을 활성화했습니다.
- 설치 전에 `설치된 게임 버전과 모드 지원 버전이 다릅니다. 설치하시겠습니까?` 팝업과 두 버전을 표시합니다.
- **예**를 선택한 요청만 빌드 불일치 설치를 허용합니다. **아니오** 또는 창 닫기는 다운로드·파일 변경 없이 취소합니다.
- 주황색 `빌드 다름` 표시, 원본 백업, 원상 복구를 유지합니다.

jayprates/nothing-ear-control-decky.name: v1.2.0
jayprates/nothing-ear-control-decky.body: No more polling: the plugin listens for BlueZ's connection signals (busctl monitor) and connects when the earbuds connect. Nothing runs while idle except the retry timers after a failed attempt. Falls back to a check every 30 s if busctl isn't available.

shaifvier/diablo-loot-filter-decky-plugi.name: 0.2.0-beta.1 · Full-screen build viewer preview
shaifvier/diablo-loot-filter-decky-plugi.body:
Full-screen Maxroll build reference viewer for Decky, with Gear, Skills and Paragon tabs, zoomable diagrams, source allocation lists and separate named character checklists.

Install the attached **diablo-loot-filters-preview-v0.2.0-beta.1.zip** using Decky settings → Developer → **Install Plugin from ZIP**. Selecting the downloaded local file avoids Decky's remote-store download-count request. Open **Diablo Loot Filters Preview → Saved builds** or load a Maxroll guide/planner and choose **View build**.

The preview has an independent plugin identity, route, runtime cache and character progress. It copies existing public build caches once. The installed stable **Diablo Loot Filters**, `main`, and stable release stay intact. No merge into `main`.

Controls: **LB/RB** tabs, **D-pad** selection, **LT/RT** zoom, **Y** fit, **A** details, **X** mark an allocated paragon node, **B** back. Mouse/touch controls are visible. Progress is scoped to character, planner, variant and source step; refreshes reconcile shared nodes and flag changes. English Maxroll references only; unknown mappings remain visible.

Validation: 34 Python tests and 3 frontend state/queue tests; CI packaging and Xvfb clipboard checks passed. Live Steam layouts checked at 1280×800 and 1920×1080, native spatial focus/details/zoom/marking exercised, and existing dropdown, search, rule scroll, generation and persistent clipboard checks repeated in the preview. Physical controller feedback and the directly installed Steam edition's in-game check remain unverified. Some seasonal names remain unmapped. See README and VALIDATION.md on the feature branch.

wx40217/decky-brightness.name: v0.1.5 — 中英文界面与默认下限说明
wx40217/decky-brightness.body:
新增简体中文与英文界面，覆盖按钮、状态和异常提示。加载时优先使用 Steam 界面语言，接口不可用时回退到浏览器首选语言；其他语言使用英文。插件内部名称保持不变，已有自定义下限和亮度控制逻辑保留。

中英文 README 已显著注明：默认 44% 仅来自作者在自己的 Steam Deck OLED 上的个人测试，不是通用的“不频闪阈值”，不保证适合其他机器或 SDR/HDR、刷新率组合；请在自己的设备上确认并保存下限。

48 项自动测试、类型检查、构建及中英文安装包界面验证通过。v0.1.5 已安装到测试 Deck，核实 Steam 中文语言识别正常，原有 44.08136% 精确下限和亮度保留。英文界面由安装包模拟验证覆盖，英文真机显示尚未验证。

仍为手动调光版本：系统自适应需关闭，下限仅限制插件内操作。此前环境光测试确认系统自适应绕过前端亮度拦截，原生最小/最大值写入未生效；本版没有开放系统自适应下限。

Adds Simplified Chinese and English UI, including status and error messages, with Steam-language detection and browser-language fallback. Existing custom floors are preserved. Both READMEs emphasize that the default 44% is based solely on personal testing on the author's own unit and is not a universal flicker-free threshold. Manual plugin controls only; system adaptive brightness must remain off.

48 automated tests, type checking, build and compiled UI validation in both languages passed. Installed on the test Deck with the original exact floor preserved; English layout on real hardware remains unverified.

wx40217/decky-brightness.name: v0.1.4 — 统一中文字体，精简调光面板
wx40217/decky-brightness.body:
统一使用 Steam Deck 系统已有的简体中文 Noto 字体，增大微调按钮和状态文字。精简面板，删除重复说明、兼容性占位内容和日常无须使用的检查按钮；已有精确下限完整保留。

42 项自动测试、类型检查、构建及安装包界面验证通过。已在 Steam Deck OLED / SteamOS 3.8.28 / Decky 3.2.9 上核实字体和按钮布局，并在《赛博朋克 2077》SDR、HDR10 PQ 动态 3D 基准场景的实际 60、90 Hz 下验证：关闭插件面板后调亮、返回精确下限均成功，实际背光读数随之变化。HDR 游戏内容反馈及元数据已确认。

45 的目标帧率请求被映射成 90 Hz，实际 45 Hz 尚未验证。同一控制百分比在 SDR、HDR 下的背光读数不同，调光验证不代表物理频闪已消除。本次临时绕过 MAKO 隐藏 HDR 的启动包装器，测试后恢复原设置；开启 MAKO 时的 HDR 组合尚未验证。系统自适应下限仍未开放。

安装包保持 v0.1.4，不包含任何临时探查接口；本次仅更新真机验证说明。

wx40217/decky-brightness.name: v0.1.3 — 默认下限 44%，自动读取系统自适应
wx40217/decky-brightness.body: 没有自定义配置时，亮度下限默认使用 44%；已有自定义下限保留原始精度。直接读取并监听 Steam 系统自适应状态，移除手动确认开关；自适应开启或读取失败时暂停插件调光，关闭后自动恢复。每次调光前重新读取系统状态，并处理 Steam 浮点舍入，避免回报越过下限。28 项 TypeScript 和 14 项 Python 测试、类型检查、构建及安装包界面验证通过，已在 Steam Deck OLED / SteamOS 3.8.28 / Decky 3.2.9 上安装验证真实状态读取、微调、下限限制及配置保留。此版仍仅限制插件内调光，尚未实现系统自适应亮度下限；44% 是作者个人校准值，SDR、HDR 和刷新率兼容性需分别验证。

wx40217/decky-brightness.name: v0.1.2：校准调光与精细微调
wx40217/decky-brightness.body: 未设置下限时，确认系统自适应已关闭即可在 0–100% 范围内校准。滑块步长为 0.01 个百分点，新增 ±0.01、±0.1 个百分点微调按钮，连续点击按待处理目标累加。保存后，滑块和微调统一受原始精度下限限制。收紧系统亮度确认误差，避免旧回报误判成功。30 项自动测试、类型检查、构建与编译后插件验证通过。系统自适应下限仍未开放。

wx40217/decky-brightness.name: v0.1.1：修复游戏模式检测
wx40217/decky-brightness.body: 修复 Gamescope 主线程更名为 gamescope-wl 后被误判为桌面模式、持续清空当前亮度的问题。新增可执行文件识别，并在当前亮度旁显示停用原因。26 项自动测试、类型检查、构建和编译后插件验证通过。本版仍为插件内手动调光，系统自适应下限尚未开放。

konst2/decky-translator-ru.body:
## Оптимизация
- файл с зависимостями, который выкачивается при установке плагина уменьшен со 180 Мб до 24 Мб. Теперь установка значительно быстрее

## AI методы перевода
Добавлен blacklist для словарика который формируется при AI переводе. Пока это только GigaChat+. Качество перевода немного выросло.

# ВНИМАНИЕ!
Эксперементальный релиз.
Ставить только на свой страх и риск!
Может перестать работать что-угодно.

## Оптимизация
- пытаемся выкинуть весь мусор из plugin-dependencies.tar и пережать его более оптимально.

## Оверлей
- Окна Steam больше не прячутся под переводом: окна настройки плагина, экранная клавиатура и т.д. теперь открываются поверх снимка. Раньше они работали, и оставались невидимыми под оверлеем.

## Распознавание
- На экранах, где OCR выдал каждую строку отдельным блоком, строки одного абзаца снова собираются в абзац, а не переводятся по одной.

## Управление
- "Время открытия" и "Время закрытия" можно поставить на 0. Тогда перевод запускается или оверлей закрывается простым нажатием, без удержания.

## Баги
- Кнопка иногда могла не срабатывать после перевода или закрытия оверлея.

## AI методы перевода
- Чиним проблему из-за которой AI модель от сбера временами воспринимает элементы интерфейса (надписи на них) как контекст игры

## AI методы перевода
- Запоминает манеру речи персонажей и передаёт её модели. При смене манеры обновляется.
- Попытка навести порядок в обращениях "Ты" и "Вы".

## Интерфейс
- На форме словаря имён модели теперь виден пол персонажа и его манера речи.

kongdayan/decky-agent-remote.name: v0.5.0 — DeepSeek Harness on Deck, English + 中文
kongdayan/decky-agent-remote.body:
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) on Steam Deck now ships **English and Simplified Chinese UI**, plus independent **Mandarin / English / automatic speech recognition**. Open the conversation header to change either language without restarting. Existing connections and conversations remain intact; upgrades keep Chinese/Mandarin defaults.

- Full DeepSeek Harness name appears in agent selection and chat.
- English voice no longer receives a forced Mandarin prompt or Chinese normalization.
- Settings, owned errors and notifications follow the UI language; messages retain their original language.
- Language settings are locked during a task; recording snapshots its speech language.

Real Steam Deck → LAN bridge → local Whisper → real DSH round trips: Mandarin 4.21 s, English 4.42 s, automatic English 4.98 s. Independent community plugin. DeepSeek and DeepSeek Harness belong to their owners. Decky Store approval is not claimed. Read the setup/security/validation docs. For voice, update the host bridge as well as the Deck plugin, and use a multilingual Whisper model.

kongdayan/decky-agent-remote.name: Agent Remote v0.4.1 — DSH voice control for Steam Deck (preview)
kongdayan/decky-agent-remote.body:
First public preview of Agent Remote for Decky.

Open the remembered conversation to read the latest DSH reply. Hold a rear button to talk, release to recognize and send; history, status and voice stay on one page. Configure and switch execution machines inside the plugin. DSH is required; Codex is optional. LAN, HTTPS, SSH tunnels and VPNs work without requiring Tailscale.

Install agent-remote-v0.4.1.zip through Decky's developer ZIP installer. Verify the accompanying SHA256 first, then follow docs/SETUP.md to configure the bridge on your computer. Configs, credentials, models and recordings are not bundled. The upstream decky-api source archive is attached alongside its license included in the plugin ZIP.

Validation: 15 behavioral/backend tests, strict TypeScript check, Rollup build, publication guard and Linux GitHub CI passed. A real Steam Deck → LAN bridge → local Whisper → DSH → history test returned “连接正常” in 4.4 seconds, with 2.24 seconds for ASR. Synthetic WAV was used for that measured test. Test session archived. Physical rear-button behavior across all Steam Input layouts has not been certified.

Current limits: Chinese UI and Mandarin ASR; prerelease DSH RPC compatibility may change; some Codex desktop chats are read-only; approvals stay on the execution machine. Public screenshots use synthetic conversations and device illustrations. This is a GitHub sideload preview, not a Decky Store listing.

中文：打开即看最新回复，按住背键说话、松开发送。执行和识别都在电脑上。支持局域网，Tailscale 可选。安装、隐私及验证范围见仓库文档；请勿公开连接令牌或个人聊天截图。

mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.name: v3.4.0-rc.24
mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.body:
## Fixed

- **Forget works on a device that has a request left over.** On the Paired devices page, Forget did nothing at all, silently, on the selected device while it had a saved request: the "Status unknown" state you get when the device restarted after a request was sent. Forget now waits only while a request is actually being followed (and says so), and otherwise removes the device together with the leftover request. The Forget on the device's card and the one in the connection details work the same way.

- If your Paired devices page is stuck on "Status unknown": open it again after this version and press **Forget** on the device (then pair it again), or press **Retry request status** once: it now clears itself.

mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.name: v3.4.0-rc.23
mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.body:
## Changed

- **A browser that pairs again no longer adds a second entry on your device.** Your browser keeps a random id for each device it pairs with and sends it only to that device. When you approve a pairing from a browser the device already knows, the old entry (and its token) is replaced, so there is one. The new entry starts untrusted: turn **Trusted** on again if you want. A different browser, or one without an id (an older version), is a separate entry, as before.
- **Browsers are named by what they are.** The default name is now like "Chrome · Android" or "Edge · Windows" instead of "Browser", so the list of paired browsers on your device tells a phone from a laptop. You can still type any name.
- **"Already paired with this device."** A pairing link opened in a browser that is already paired with that device, and that the device still knows, no longer starts another pairing. **+ Add device** pairs again on purpose.

## Good to know

- Entries made before this version have no id, so they stay until you remove them in **Paired browsers**. The next pairing from that browser creates its entry with an id, and from then on re-pairing replaces it.

## Try it on your device

- Pair your phone, then pair it again from **+ Add device** and approve it: **Paired browsers** shows one entry for the phone, named like "Chrome · Android".
- Open a pairing link from the device in the phone that is already paired: it says "Already paired with this device."

## Security checks

- **Virus scan:** ClamAV found no threats in `DeckyHub-v3.4.0-rc.23.zip` ([scan report](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases/download/v3.4.0-rc.23/ClamAV-scan-v3.4.0-rc.23.txt)).

- **Desktop installer (`install-deckyhub.sh` and its `.desktop` launcher):** ClamAV: No threats found ([scan report](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases/download/v3.4.0-rc.23/ClamAV-desktop-v3.4.0-rc.23.txt)). VirusTotal: flagged (1/56) — [report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/8a6887e5dca394d07df684c1ae6e93021d7b1b6bdb0d4ce71ed32a5b7114ca63). - **The warnings and virus scans open in a window when you press Send to device.** On a plugin's page your phone now shows what the device shows before an install: runs as root, audit warnings, and the ClamAV, YARA, VirusTotal and MetaDefender results. mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.name: v3.4.0-rc.21
mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.body:
## New

- **Your phone shows the warnings and virus scans before it sends a plugin.** On a plugin's page, the card that sends it to your device has a **Check before you send** block above the button, with what the device shows before an install: runs as root, audit warnings, and the ClamAV, YARA, VirusTotal and MetaDefender results. A plugin with nothing to warn about says so.
- **Send to device sits beside Install with DeckyHub and Source on GitHub** on a plugin's page, instead of on a line of its own further down.
- **A hint after a remote install.** Decky Loader's own window can stay open on "Downloading any external binaries" after a plugin is already installed (Decky LSFG-VK, say). The phone's "Installed" message and a notice on the device now say that Decky may still be fetching extra files, that it can take a few minutes, and that you can close its window afterwards.

## Fixed

- **The installed plugins list no longer comes back empty** on the Paired devices page after a request to install, update, remove, enable or disable a plugin. It is read again as soon as the request is over (it used to come back only after refreshing the page).
- **Panel de Control's Quick Access tab shows again** next to DeckyHub's: the fix for repeated tab icons no longer stops it from adding its tab. This was in rc.20 and is now fixed.

## Try it on your device

- Open a plugin's page on your phone with a paired device: the warnings and scans appear above **Send to device**, and the button sits beside the install buttons at the top.
- Send a plugin, remove it from the Paired devices page, and check that the installed list is still there afterwards.
- Open Quick Access: DeckyHub's tab and Panel de Control's tab, one each.

## Security checks

- **Virus scan:** ClamAV found no threats in `DeckyHub-v3.4.0-rc.21.zip` ([scan report](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases/download/v3.4.0-rc.21/ClamAV-scan-v3.4.0-rc.21.txt)).

mazillka/deckyhub-plugin.body:
## New

- **Pair another browser with a link.** On the Paired devices page, a paired browser (your phone, say) can make a one-time link with **Pair another browser with a link**. Open it in the other browser (your laptop, say): it pairs by itself with its own key, and your device still asks you to approve it. The link works once, for five minutes, and carries only a one-time token in its `#` part, which never reaches the website. Your device needs this version to make links; an older one says so beside the button.

## Changed

- **DeckyHub's own tab in Quick Access is on by default** on a fresh install. Turn it off under **Settings → General → DeckyHub tab in Quick Access**. Settings you saved before keep their choice.
- **The list is the default layout for everyone.** A grid you picked before is dropped once; the Layout switch stays, and a grid you pick afterwards is kept.

## Fixed

- **Decky Loader repeating plugin tab icons in Quick Access** ([decky-loader#1014](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader/issues/1014)). DeckyHub now keeps one tab per plugin. It only removes exact repeats and never touches tabs other plugins add; Panel de Control's tab stays, and it works with or without it.

## Good to know

- The tab fix is on Decky Loader's tab hook, which Decky Loader has closed as unsupported: if a Decky update changes it, DeckyHub steps aside and the tab setting can be turned off.

## Try it on your device

- Open Quick Access: DeckyHub's tab (with Discover, Search, Settings) and any other plugin's tab, one each, however often you open the menu.
- On a paired phone, open the Paired devices page, press **Pair another browser with a link**, open the link on a laptop in Chrome or Edge on the same Wi-Fi, and approve it on the device.
- Discover, Updates and Search open as a list.

## Security checks

- **Virus scan:** ClamAV found no threats in `DeckyHub-v3.4.0-rc.20.zip` ([scan report](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases/download/v3.4.0-rc.20/ClamAV-scan-v3.4.0-rc.20.txt)).

## New

- Use the Ko-fi link if you’d like to support DeckyHub.

## Changed

- DeckyHub checks that an installed plugin comes from the expected GitHub owner and repository before offering an update. If it can’t verify the match, the plugin card and Manage window show an explanation. You can also find reported identity problems on the [Known Issues page](https://deckyhub.com/known-issues.html).
- “Scan pending” and “Not scanned yet” now appear in red so they’re easier to spot. Confirmed findings still have their own labels.

## Fixed

- Plugins that list their GitHub repository with a `git+https://` address can now be matched correctly and receive updates.
- If multiple installed plugins share the same name, DeckyHub blocks updates and uninstalls that could affect the wrong plugin.
- DeckyHub keeps release scan results separate from installed copies it can’t verify.

## Try it on your device

- Open DeckyHub from Quick Access and check whether your installed plugins show the updates you expect.
- If a plugin shows a repository warning, open Manage to see the details.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/compare/v3.3.0...v3.3.1)
